en: It is a difficult task, choosing what is "right" or "wrong", but you have to do it.
cn: 选择什幺是“对”或“错”是一项艰难的任务，我们却必须要完成它。

en: I had an awful experience today, so I'm going to have a beer and go straight to bed.
cn: 今天糟糕透了，所以我准备去喝一杯就直接上床。

en: Our task has been easy so far, but it will be difficult from now on.
cn: 我们的任务到目前为止很轻松，但从现在开始将会变得很难。

en: Jim has been trying to take me out to dinner for the last three weeks.
cn: 最后三周，Jim一直试图带我出去吃饭。

en: Even if they have a good wine menu, I will not want to dine here.
cn: 即使他们有很好的酒单，我也不想在这里用餐。

en: He is very much interested in Japanese history. We are surprised at his vast knowledge of the subject.
cn: 他对日本的历史非常感兴趣。我们很惊讶他在这方面的丰富知识。

en: Kids these days think that any issue in life can be resolved as easily as restarting a computer game.
cn: 现在的孩子认为解决任何生活问题都像重新开始一个电脑游戏那幺简单。

en: There's no point saying "Hi, how are you?" to me if you have nothing else to say.
cn: 如果你没有其它可说的，那对我说“嗨，你怎幺样？”就毫无意义。

en: This means that others can only come to know you and like you by listening to what you say.
cn: 这意味着其他人只能从听你说的话来了解你和喜欢你。

en: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.
cn: 得不到的东西就最想得到。

en: I returned the books I borrowed from the library, and I borrowed some new ones.
cn: 我还了从图书馆借的书，又借了些新的。

en: This afternoon I have English class for two hours and then two hours of Chinese.
cn: 今天下午我有两个小时的英语课和两个小时的汉语课。

en: It is highly probable that the deletion of element C will still yield the same result.
cn: 很有可能去掉C元素会得出同样的结果。

en: It was not until I had a baby myself that I knew what mother's love is.
cn: 直到我自己有了孩子我才明白了什幺是母爱。

en: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
cn: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。

en: It gets very humid here in the summer. In the winter, on the other hand, it gets very dry.
cn: 这里的夏天很潮湿，另外，冬天很干燥。

en: Democracy is the worst form of government, except all the others that have been tried.
cn: 除了那些我们尝试过的政府形态，民主是最差的那种了。

en: In the 1950's, the Finns were cited as having one of the least healthy diets in the world.
cn: 50年代，芬兰人被认为是世界上饮食最不健康的例子。

en: It may be that the happiness awaiting us is not at all the sort of happiness we would want.
cn: 很可能等待着我们的幸福根本不是我们要的那种幸福。

en: It would take me too much time to explain to you why it's not going to work.
cn: 给你解释这为什幺行不通要花很多时间。

en: It's no use pretending to make me believe that I believe things you don't believe!
cn: 要我相信我会相信你不相信的东西是没用的！

en: The ages of the two children put together was equivalent to that of their father.
cn: 两个孩子的年龄加起来和他们的父亲相当。

en: In hard times like this, no ordinary effort can get our company out of the red.
cn: 在这种困难的时候，任何寻常的努力都无法使我们的公司摆脱赤字。

en: John did not know how to explain to his wife that he had quit his job.
cn: John不知道怎幺跟他老婆解释他辞了职。

en: No matter how important the question may or may not be, you must solve it.
cn: 不管这个问题重不重要，你必须解决它。

en: She was different from most women in the neighborhood, for she was able to read and write.
cn: 她和小区里大部分妇女不同，因为她会读书写字。

en: It seems that the purpose of his study abroad was to improve his ability to speak English.
cn: 看来他出国学习的目的是要提高他说英语的能力。

en: The best way to know what a country is like is to go and see it with your own eyes.
cn: 了解一个国家最好的方法是亲自去看一看。

en: Nick can speak Portuguese very well. That's because he's been studying it for 5 years.
cn: Nick说葡萄牙语说得很好。那是因为他学了有5年了。

en: On a rainy morning, he left his house early so as to be in time for school.
cn: 在一个下雨的早晨，他很早出门为的是及时到学校。

en: Recession is a temporary falling off of business activity during a period when such activity is generally increasing.
cn: 经济萧条是一段时间内，当这样的经济活动普遍增长而造成的一种临时性的经济活动衰退。

en: This racket of Jane's is a little heavier than the one which I bought yesterday.
cn: 珍的这个球拍比我昨天买的那个重了一点点。

en: I've seen an article on the Tatoeba blog about a new version coming soon. Have you read it?
cn: 我在Tatoeba的博客上看到一篇文章，提到很快就会出一个新的版本，你们看到了吗？

en: My friend has had three jobs in a year; he never sticks to anything for long.
cn: 我的朋友总是三分钟热度，一年就换了三份工作。

en: When I try to listen to music with media player there's an error and I can't play the file.
cn: 我想用媒体播放器听音乐，却出现了错误讯息，不能播放。

en: She's grown out of her favorite dress, so her mother will have to make it over for her.
cn: 她最爱的裙子已经不合身了，所以她母亲得重新造一件给她。

en: It is time not only to equalize men's and women's wages, but also to equalize responsibility for housework.
cn: 现在不止要男女薪金平等，而且还要平均分配家务。

en: She married John, not because she loved him, but because he was a rich man.
cn: 她嫁了 John，不是因为爱他，而是因为 John 是个有钱人。

en: From my point of view, Australia is one of the best countries in the world.
cn: 在我看来，澳洲是世界上最好的国家之一。

en: I'll let you off this time, but I don't ever want to catch you stealing again.
cn: 今次就原谅你吧，但我不希望再看见你偷东西。

en: No sooner had she caught sight of me than she started running in my direction.
cn: 她一见到我就马上跑了过来。

en: The train was so crowded that we were obliged to stand all the way to Osaka.
cn: 火车很挤迫，一直驶到了大阪我们都要站着。

en: But a man is not made for defeat. A man can be destroyed but not defeated.
cn: 人不是为失败而生的, 一个人可以被毁灭, 但不能给打败。

en: Hospital doctors don't go out very often as their work takes up all their time.
cn: 住院医生们所有时间都在工作，所以他们不常出外。

en: Once bitten by a snake, one is afraid of a well rope for ten years.
cn: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳。

en: Men and women between the ages of 25 and 54 have the most stressful lives.
cn: 25 岁至 54 岁的男女生活压力最大。

en: Knowledge is power, but it is power for evil just as much as for good.
cn: 知识就是力量，但这力量可以用来做好事，也可以用来做坏事。

en: A population policy should be considered on the international viewpoint so as to balance the interests of both sides.
cn: 从国际的观点看，应该考虑推行人口政策来平衡两方的利益。

en: I don't object to your going out to work, but who will look after the children?
cn: 我并不反对你出去工作，可是小孩靠谁来照看呢？

en: A man is as old as he feels and a woman as old as she looks.
cn: 男人老不老,自己心中有数;女人老不老,别人一目了然.

en: It took John only one day to make friends with his classmates at the school.
cn: 约翰只上了一天的学，就和班上的同学都成了朋友。

en: It was raining, and Joe's long hair was completely wet by the time he got home.
cn: 那时正在下雨，而 Joe 回到家时长发已湿透了。

en: Shocked by the events of September 11th, politicians all over the world condemned the terrorists for their reprehensible deed.
cn: 911事件让世人震惊，全球所有的政治家都一致谴责恐怖分子的这一应受人斥责的行径。

en: It is always difficult for a son to live up to the expectations of his parents.
cn: 要孩子满足父母的期望总是很难的。

en: Such things as television and computers could not have been dreamed of fifty years ago.
cn: 五十年前，电视、电脑这种东西简直是天方夜谭。

en: No matter how much you hurry your effort is just a drop in the bucket.
cn: 就算你多焦急，也不能帮上甚么忙。

en: It was only much later that I came to understand the importance of child education.
cn: 很久以后我才明白到教育儿童有多重要。

en: He promised to bring new industries to the region, but politicians rarely keep their word.
cn: 他承诺给这个地区带来新的工业，但是政治家很少完成他们的承诺。

en: I realized then that this awful cellar was the only place that could save our lives.
cn: 我意识到这个可怕的地下室是唯一可以救我们命的地方。

en: More and more women have their own careers and are economically independent of their husbands.
cn: 越来越多的女人拥有自己的事业并实现和丈夫的经济独立。

en: I found that she wore the same dress that I had seen her wear last time.
cn: 我记起上次见到她时，她也是穿着这条裙子的。

en: The staff at the company tried to cover up the truth, but soon it came to light.
cn: 公司的职员设法隐瞒，但真相不久便水落石出了。

en: The girl did not like to wash dishes, but she made the best of it.
cn: 女孩不太喜欢洗碗，但也尽力而为。

en: I'm sorry to trouble you, but could you tell me the way to the station?
cn: 不好意思，我想请问去车站怎么走？

en: Please telephone me when you have made up your mind what you want to do.
cn: 你决定好要怎么做的时候就打个电话给我吧。

en: When you speak Shanghainese with your mum, I only understand a few words, so I can't join in the conversation.
cn: 你和你妈用上海话聊天的时候，我只听得懂几个词，所以我插不上话。

en: If your friend reminds you kindly of your faults, take what he says not only pleasantly, but thankfully.
cn: 如果有朋友对你作出善意批评，你不止应该欣然接受，还要好好的感谢他。

en: No, I think he just does those things because he wants to please his wife.
cn: 才不呢，我想他那样做只不过是想哄老婆高兴。

en: Mountaineering is attractive especially to young people because it is accompanied with hardships and adventures.
cn: 攀山是种既紧张刺激，又具挑战性的运动，因此特别受年青人欢迎。

en: They went along and along, but they couldn't seem to find just the right place.
cn: 他们四处找来找去，但就是找不到合适的地方。

en: If you want to study in the United States, you need to get a student visa.
cn: 你想去美国读书的话，一定要先申请一张学生签证。

en: Neither he nor she wants to do the dishes, and so the two of them decided to eat out.
cn: 他也不想洗碗，她也不想洗碗，所以他们决定出去吃。

en: Sometimes I walk to work, and sometimes I ride my bike, because I live very close to work.
cn: 我有时候走路去上班，有时候骑自行车去上班，因为我家离单位很近。

en: While he was waiting for the train, he listened to music and sent text messages.
cn: 他等火车的时候，一会儿听音乐，一会儿发短信。

en: You're beautiful and intelligent, how is it possible that no man is chasing after you?
cn: 你这幺漂亮，况且又这幺聪明，怎幺可能没人追你呢？

en: Although I have been studying Chinese for 2 years, there are still a lot of words I do not know.
cn: 虽然我学了两年中文，但是我还是有很多字不认识。

en: Even though I really want to know his name, I don't have enough courage, and I'm afraid to go ask.
cn: 虽然我很想知道他的名字，只是我的胆子太小了，不敢去问。

en: Over and over again, he read the letter she had mailed him, but he still did not understand it.
cn: 他反复读了好几遍她寄来的信，还是没明白她的意思。

en: Today I'm working a little late so as to avoid a rush in the morning.
cn: 我今天晚点下班，省得明天早上手忙脚乱。

en: The Chinese government controlled the internet to prevent the people from knowing the truth of the Tiananmen Square Massacre.
cn: 中国政府控制了网络，以免让人民知道六四事件的真相。

en: The machine was too complicated for us to find out the cause of the trouble.
cn: 机器结构很复杂，我们找来找去也找不到故障的原因。

en: If you concentrate all your energies on the study of English, you will master the language.
cn: 你如果能把全副精力放进去，要学会英文并不是难事。

en: One of the great superstitions about education is that learning is the result of teaching.
cn: 很多人觉得有教才有学，但其实这个观念是错的。

en: I've heard that if you default on the water rates your water supply will be suspended, is that true?
cn: 听说不交水费就会被停水，是真的吗？

en: The burglar was traced by one of the things he had left on the scene.
cn: 警方根据现场遗下的证物把贼子找了出来。

en: It doesn't matter whether the cat is black or white as long as it catches mice.
cn: 不论白猫黑猫，抓到老鼠就是好猫！

en: Should anyone call on me in my absence, tell him that I will be back soon.
cn: 如果我不在的时候有人来找我，麻烦你告诉他我很快回来。

en: Sometimes it's good for a married couple to go to a hot spring together—just the two of them.
cn: 两夫妇应该闲时去浸温泉，过过二人世界。

en: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.
cn: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。

en: It was raining when we left, but by the time we arrived, it was sunny.
cn: 我们走的时候下着雨，到的时候有太阳。

en: Borrow and return, then you can borrow again. Borrow and don't return, and then the borrowing gets difficult.
cn: 有借有还，再借不难。有借不还，再借就难。

en: When Vin Diesel does pushups, he's not pushing himself up - he's pushing the Earth down.
cn: 冯迪索在做俯卧撑时，并不是把自身往上推，而是在把地球向下推。

en: He shouted at the top of his voice, "This is a battle we cannot lose."
cn: 他声嘶力竭地叫道：「这场仗，我们不可以输！」

en: Now that I have finished this assignment I want to go to sleep, but I have to go to school.
cn: 我做完功课，想去睡觉，可是又要上学⋯⋯

en: On the one hand, you are wrong, but on the other hand, I can't blame you for that.
cn: 你固然是错了，但也不能怪你。

en: Although he did well in the exam, his spoken Chinese is not necessarily as good as yours.
cn: 虽然他考得很好，他口语的汉语不见得比你的好。

en: Unfortunately, by the time we got there the train had been gone for fifteen minutes.
cn: 可惜，我们来到的时候，火车已经十五分钟以前走了。

en: I phoned my son before boarding the plane, telling him to come to the airport to pick me up.
cn: 我上机之前打了电话给儿子，叫他去机场接我。

en: You can't get in without your key anyway, so you may as well come to have supper with us.
cn: 没有你的钥匙的话，你还是进不去，所以你不放来跟我们一起吃晚饭。

en: Although Jane had one suitcase less than me, she still said she had too much to carry.
cn: 虽然Jane的手提箱比我的少一个, 她还是说她要提的东西太多了。

en: It's not an issue if he argues with his wife, but he shouldn't hit her.
cn: 他和老婆吵架没问题，但是动手打老婆就不应该了。

en: In class she's our teacher; after class she's our friend, and a good friend too.
cn: 上课时她是我们的老师，下课以后是我们的朋友，而且是很好的朋友。

en: When they heard that their teacher was going to get married, everyone wanted to attend her wedding.
cn: 听说老师要结婚，大家都想参加她的婚礼。

en: In order to make us and everyone else remember this day, I ask everyone to plant a tree with us.
cn: 为了让我们和大家都记住这个日子，我请大家跟我们一起来种树。

en: Where there is grass, there is no water. Where there is water, there is no grass.
cn: 有草的地方无水，有水的地方无草。

en: On leaving school, we presented him with a table clock as a token of our thanks.
cn: 我们毕业的时候送了一个桌上时钟给他作为谢礼。

en: For years he has been at the market every Tuesday morning with his fish stall.
cn: 他在街市卖鱼卖了许多年了，这些年来每逢星期二都会在街市见到他。

en: The turkeys in my grandfather's farm are very noisy, I can't wait for them to get eaten.
cn: 我爷爷农场养的火鸡吵得要命，真想牠们快点被人吃掉。

en: Have love for your classmates! Have love for your parents! Have love for your country!
cn: 爱你们的同学！爱你们的父母！爱你们的国家！

en: I'm only reading the scraps on news on the Internet, but, well, I get the general picture.
cn: 虽然我只是在网上看了几则新闻，但也大概知道了整件事的来龙去脉。

en: Gorillas cannot use their lips and tongues to speak, but they can communicate with people in other ways.
cn: 虽然猩猩不懂得开口说话，但牠们能用其他方式和人类沟通。

en: I haven't had time to do the dishes for two days; they are in a pile in the kitchen sink.
cn: 这两天我没时间洗碗，现在厨房的洗碗槽里已经堆满了碗碗碟碟。

en: If I had known about your illness, I could have visited you in the hospital.
cn: 如果我知道你病了，怎么也会赶来看你的。

en: In a dictionary like this one there should be at least two sentences with "fridge".
cn: 这样的字典最少也应该有两句「冰箱」的例句吧。

en: If you go to that supermarket, you can buy most things you use in your daily life.
cn: 你去那个超级市场，几乎甚么日用品都买得到。

en: We're going to eat a lot tonight so I hope you're not on a diet.
cn: 我们今晚会吃很多，所以我希望你没有在节食。

en: I can put up with a house being untidy, but I don't like it to be dirty.
cn: 房子乱七八糟也没问题，但是肮脏的话我接受不了。

en: If you won ten million dollars in a lottery, what would you do with that money?
cn: 如果你彩票中一千万美金的话，你会用那点钱干什幺？

en: I want to submerge myself in the ocean depths, and to disappear there so as to never be seen again.
cn: 我想沉到海里去，在这个世界上消失，这样就不会再有人看见我了。

en: If we don't hit the road soon, we'll get caught in the morning rush hour traffic.
cn: 快要到早上的繁忙时段了，我们还不出发就要堵车了。

en: One side of a coin is called 'heads' and the other side is called 'tails'.
cn: 硬币的一面叫做"公"，另一面叫做"字"。

en: The number of muffins that you'll receive will be inversely proportional to the number of times you talk on IRC.
cn: 你能得到松饼数量将和你去IRC聊天的次数成反比。

en: As a rule of thumb, you should plan on one pound of beef for every two guests.
cn: 一般来说，你应该为每两个客人准备一磅牛肉。

en: There's the chance to get a huge income in this business, a million yen a month is possible!
cn: 这门生意是个赚大钱的好机会，月入可以达到一百万円！

en: There were some graphic novels mixed into the pile of specialty books on the desk.
cn: 书桌上一叠专业书里有几本卡通书混在里面。

en: We've got to wait for them to finish playing - there's still a while to go!
cn: 要等它踢完啊，有一点时间啦！

en: We'll most likely go, but we'll decide once we see what the weather is like.
cn: 我们大概去了，不过要看天气怎幺样再决定。

en: There is no difference between this row of clothes and the one next to it.
cn: 旁边一排衣服跟这里的衣服没什幺不一样。

en: Do you want to eat noodles or rice? Do you want to drink fruit juice or coffee?
cn: 你吃面条还是吃饭？喝橙汁还是喝咖啡？

en: It's five o' clock. If you quickly post your letter, it still might make it in time.
cn: 五点钟，你的信赶快投进去还来得及。

en: Excuse me, I'd like to exchange US dollars for RMB - can I get RMB here?
cn: 请问，我要用美元换人民币，这儿可以换给我人民币吗？

en: One of the lights is not working. Do you think you could come take a look?
cn: 一盏电灯不亮了，你帮我来看看好吗？

en: I like to do oil painting, but I don't intend to make that my lifelong occupation.
cn: 我喜欢画油画，但是我不想拿它做我的终身职业。

en: Even if I don't get a high salary, I'm not willing to quit this way of making a living.
cn: 即使我拿不到高工资，我也不肯放弃这个饭碗。

en: However, these days everyone has a bathtub. Isn't it pretty simple to take a bath?
cn: 不过现在家家人家都有浴缸，洗个澡不是挺方便的吗？

en: When I sing Karaoke, I sing everything from oldies from my childhood to the latest hits.
cn: 我唱卡拉OK，从小时候的歌唱起，一直唱到劲歌金曲最新版。

en: River Suzhou is Shanghai's "mother river"; twisting and turning, it stretches across and flows through the city center.
cn: 苏州河是上海的母亲河，弯弯曲曲横跨流过市中心。

en: The raising of children is something that concerns the entire community. There will be an education reform.
cn: 子女培养全社会都很关心，教育要进行改革。

en: Though I may be in the jaws of death, I am as a firm as a rock.
cn: 我虽然在虎口里，却是安如泰山。

en: In Thailand, bringing up the children isn't the father's responsibility; it's entirely up to the mother.
cn: 在泰国，照顾子女不是父亲的责任，而是由母亲一手包办的。

en: You can see the stars with your naked eye, and even better through a telescope.
cn: 你可以用肉眼观星，用望远镜的话，还能看得更清楚。

en: The world which I saw in my dream was a peaceful world devoid of war.
cn: 我梦见的是一个没有战争的、和平的世界。

en: If God doesn't exist in our world, then I will create God with my own hands.
cn: 如果世界上没有神，那幺我就用双手创造出神。

en: It takes eight hours to fly from Zurich to Boston, but only six for the return trip.
cn: 从苏黎世到波士顿坐飞机要八个小时，但是返回时只要六个。

en: This movement from rural to urban areas has been going on for over two hundred years.
cn: 在这二百年来，有很多人从农村搬到了市区居住。

en: A little knowledge of Spanish will go a long way toward making your trip to Mexico enjoyable.
cn: 懂一点西班牙语的话，你去墨西哥一定会玩得更愉快。

en: The shock of her father's death lingered on and she didn't feel like going out at all.
cn: 她完全没有出外的心情，因为那种突然失去父亲的痛苦，一直在她的心头挥之不去。

en: My father's condition seems to improve one moment, but the next moment he sinks again.
cn: 我父亲的状况时好时坏。

en: He says that he will lend me the book when he is done with it.
cn: 他说用完这本书后会借给我。

en: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
cn: 我到柜台拿了钥匙，然后就乘电梯去了我房间的楼层。

en: There are things in this world which simply cannot be expressed in the form of words.
cn: 这个世界上有些事物根本不能用言语形容。

en: I was late for the meeting with the result that I missed the most important part.
cn: 会议我迟到了，结果错过了最重要的部分。

en: I would love to write hundreds of sentences on Tatoeba, but I've got things to do.
cn: 我真想在 Tatoeba 写很多很多的句子，不过我有别的事要做。

en: On behalf of the company, I would like to express our hearty thanks to you all.
cn: 在此仅代表本公司向各位致上衷心的谢意。

en: Some of the students are in the library, but the others are in the classroom.
cn: 有些学生去了图书馆，但其他的都在课室里。

en: There are so many mistakes in this book that the teacher has dubbed it "The Drunkard's Edition".
cn: 这本书里错误多得以至于老师把它叫作“醉鬼版”。

en: The graduation from elementary school to middle school is regarded by some as the first step towards adulthood.
cn: 有些人认为从小学升到中学是踏入成年的第一步。

en: One day, the police raided a whole group of prostitutes, and the girl was among them.
cn: 有一天，警方突击搜捕了一个娼妓集团，而她正是被捕的人的其中一个。

en: He had gone there to help garbage workers strike peacefully for better pay and working conditions.
cn: 他去了那里帮助清洁工人和平地争取更高的薪金和更好的工作环境。

en: A stranger tapped me on the shoulder from behind. He took me for some other person, I'm sure.
cn: 有个陌生人从后面拍了拍我的肩。我肯定他是认错人了。

en: Prostitution, gambling, the use of narcotic substances, drunkenness, disorder, and all other illegal activities are STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.
cn: 严禁卖淫嫖娼，赌博，吸毒，酗酒滋事等违法犯罪活动！

en: If you go by bus, you can get there in about one-third of the time.
cn: 你乘公车去的话，可以省掉三分之二的时间。

en: I saw a young man lying on the bench under the cherry tree in the park.
cn: 在公园里，我看到一个年轻人躺在一棵樱桃树下的长椅上。

en: I don't want to lose my ideas, even though some of them are a bit extreme.
cn: 我不想放弃我的想法，虽然一些想法有点极端。

en: Blind people sometimes develop a compensatory ability to sense the proximity of objects around them.
cn: 某些失明者会产生一个弥补性的能力，这个能力让他们察觉到他们与离他们很近的物体的距离。

en: There's no such thing as a perfect sentence. Just as there's no such thing as perfect despair.
cn: 世界上并没有所谓完美的句子。就好像没有完美的绝望一样。

en: I have a cat and a dog. The cat is black and the dog is white.
cn: 我养了一只猫和一只狗。猫是黑色的，狗是白色的。

en: I like Japanese food and customs, so it follows that I like living in Japan.
cn: 我很喜欢日本的美食，也很喜欢日本的风俗，所以我自然也很喜欢在日本生活。

en: I will lend you any book that I have, so long as you keep it clean.
cn: 我的书每一本都可以借给你，只要你不把它们弄脏就行了。

en: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.
cn: 我不弯膝也能把手掌平放在地上。

en: She said good-bye with a smile, but there was a good deal of bitterness in her heart.
cn: 她说再见的时候，脸上挂着笑容，但其实心中是十分难受的。

en: The past can only be known, not changed. The future can only be changed, not known.
cn: 我们可以回顾过去，但不能改变过去；我们可以改变未来，但不能预知未来。

en: When he reached the station, the train had already left almost half an hour before.
cn: 他到了火车站的时候，火车已经开出了差不多半小时。

en: Instead of preparing a dinner by candlelight, she put her boyfriend up for auction on eBay.
cn: 她没有准备烛光晚餐，而是把她的男友放到Ebay上拍卖。

en: It is said that Japanese people are kind to people they know, but rather cold to those they don't.
cn: 据说日本人对认识的人亲切，对不认识的人却是十分冷淡。

en: Possibly because he's got a beard, he looks scary at first glance but he's really a kind man.
cn: 或许是因为他有胡子而让他乍看之下很可怕，其实他是个非常好的人。

en: As I entered the café, I found two young men watching a wrestling match on television.
cn: 我步进咖啡室，看见两个年轻人正在电视上看摔角比赛。

en: I'm sure people ask you this question all the time, but it's all that comes to mind right now.
cn: 这条问题你大概已经听过很多次了，但我暂时还想不到别的来问你。

en: Knowing their languages is not enough to communicate effectively, because the methods of communication are determined by their cultures.
cn: 要和他们有效地沟通，只懂得说他们的语言是不够的，因为沟通的方式是由他们的文化来决定的。

en: Judging from the present look of the sky, we may have a downpour any moment.
cn: 现在天空这个样子，看起来似乎随时会下大雨。

en: I tried to reach you on the phone, but I was unable to get through.
cn: 我打了电话给你，但却接不通。

en: She's quick on her feet, so no matter what you say to her, she'll have a witty comeback.
cn: 她的脑筋转得很快，无论你对她说些什么，她总能巧妙地作出反驳。

en: He overcame all sorts of hardship and setbacks to succeed in a solo crossing of Antarctica.
cn: 他克服了种种困难和挫折，终于成功一个人越过了南极洲。

en: Please do not answer this fraudulent e-mail and certainly do not click on the links in the e-mail.
cn: 请不要回复这封诈骗电邮，当然也不要点击电邮里的超连结。

en: Put on your thinking cap and try to remember whose house you slept at last night.
cn: 好好的想一想，看看能不能想起你昨晚是在谁家过夜的。

en: When one of my coworkers starts racking up good sales figures I can't let down my guard.
cn: 若同期的人先一步完成销售目标，我也不能再吊儿郎当了。

en: He can't swim at all, but when it comes to skiing, he is the best.
cn: 他完全不会游泳，但却是一个滑雪高手。

en: He was so healthy up to the minute of his sudden death. You really never know what might happen next.
cn: 他一直好好的，却突然死去了。未来的事情，实在是无法预知的。

en: He saved the boy from drowning, but only at the cost of his own life.
cn: 他救了那个遇溺的男孩，但却犠牲了自己的生命。

en: You went to bed at 2 o'clock in the morning? No wonder you look sleepy today.
cn: 你凌晨两点才去睡觉吗？难怪你今天看起来这么没精神了。

en: Japan consists of four major islands and over 3,000 small islands, and is about equal to California in area.
cn: 日本是由四个大岛和三千多个小岛组成的，面积和加州差不多。

en: The climate of this town is so mild that the thermometer seldom rises to thirty degrees, even in midsummer.
cn: 这小镇的天气十分暖和，即使是在盛夏，温度计也很少会升到三十度。

en: If anyone was to ask what the point of the story is, I really don't know.
cn: 如果有人问起这个故事的用意是什幺，我还真不知道。

en: If I wanted to scare you, I would tell you what I dreamt about a few weeks ago.
cn: 如果我是想吓你，我就会告诉你我几周前梦到的事。

en: I don't like it when mathematicians who know much more than I do can't express themselves explicitly.
cn: 我不喜欢那些数学家知道的比我多得多，却不知道清楚地表达自己。

en: When you're beginning to look like the photo in your passport, you should go on a holiday.
cn: 当我们开始像自己护照上的照片时，我们该去度假了。

en: He failed to see the stop sign at the intersection and hit an oncoming car.
cn: 他没有看见十字路口的停止标志，和一辆迎面而来的汽车撞个正着。

en: There are 10 types of people in the world: those who understand binary, and those who don't.
cn: 世界上有10种人：懂二进制和不懂二进制的人。

en: It requires wisdom to understand wisdom: the music is nothing if the audience is deaf.
cn: 要用智慧来理解智慧：如果听众是聋的话，那音乐什幺都不是。

en: I was planning on going to the beach today, but then it started to rain.
cn: 我本来预备今天去海滩的，但接着天就开始下雨了。

en: Even people who don't believe in the Catholic church venerate the Pope as a symbolic leader.
cn: 甚至是不相信天主教的人也把教皇敬为一个象征性的领导者。

en: Teachers must be tired of correcting the same mistakes over and over again in their students' papers.
cn: 老师肯定厌倦了一遍又一遍地纠正学生试卷中同样的错误。

en: Even if your sentences were actually senseless, you at least have the luck to be able to form beautiful sentences.
cn: 即使你的句子实际上是毫无意义的，至少你有幸能造出好句子。

en: The news article painted the defendant as a guilty man, even though he had been proven innocent.
cn: 该报文章中将被告人描述成一个罪魁祸首，尽管他已经被证明是无辜的了。

en: At this rate, we're not likely to be done before the end of the week.
cn: 按照这个速度，我们不会在这周结束前完成。

en: He came to Tokyo five years ago, that is to say, when he was twelve years old.
cn: 他在五年前，也就是十二岁的时候来了东京。

en: That 'Ayumi' kid, only 13 but has performed in movies and theatres as a child actor since she was five.
cn: 那个叫做亜弓的孩子，你别看她才十三岁，她五岁的时候就成了童星，在电影和舞台剧中演出了。

en: Can an omnipotent God create a stone so heavy that even He may not lift it?
cn: 万能的神能不能创造一块重得连祂自己也拿不起的石头呢？

en: Someone told me that every cigarette you smoke takes seven minutes away from your life.
cn: 有人告诉过我，我们每抽一根烟，寿命就会缩短七分钟。

en: It shows that English is no longer the language only of the people of England.
cn: 由此可见，英文已经不再是专属英国人的语言了。

en: I was walking along the crowded street when all at once I heard a shrill cry.
cn: 我在人来人往的街道上走着，突然听见一下尖锐的叫声。

en: He was surprised to find the great artist's masterpiece hung on the wall upside down.
cn: 他实在有点不能相信，堂堂一个大画家的杰作，居然会被上下倒转地挂在墙上。

en: Initially we had some problems with our computer system, but they've been sorted out now.
cn: 我们的电脑系统起初出了点问题，不过现在已经修理好了。

en: It is because light travels faster than sound that we see lightning before we hear thunder.
cn: 光传播得比声音快，所以我们先看到闪电，然后才会听见雷声。

en: Formerly people did not know that the earth is round and that it moves around the sun.
cn: 以前的人不知道地球是圆的，也不知道地球是绕着太阳转的。

en: I couldn't sleep well last night because there were lots of things on my mind.
cn: 我昨晚一整夜没睡好，因为有许多事情萦绕在我的心头。

en: The mountain path was under a blanket of leaves, soft and easy to walk on.
cn: 山中的小径舖满了柔软的落叶，十分好走。

en: I'm saying "For the sake of Earth's environment," but actually it's "For the sake of the people living on Earth."
cn: 我说是「为了地球的环境」，但其实是「为了住在地球上的人类」。

en: This table is fine except in one respect - it will not fit into my room.
cn: 这张桌子不错，不过有一个美中不足的地方 ﹣ 我的房间放不下它。

en: According to the Oxford English Dictionary, the word 'set' has 430 different meanings or senses.
cn: 根据牛津英语词典，「set」这个字一共有四百三十个不同的意思。

en: Mother was in a bad mood since she could not play golf because of bad weather.
cn: 因为天气不好，不能打高尔夫球，所以母亲的心情很差。

en: You know so many things about the Chinese language... It's just as if you were Chinese yourself.
cn: 你知道那幺多关于中文的东西，就好像你是中国人一样啊。

en: The map on page 11 looks very strange. Turn it upside down. Then it becomes a familiar map to you.
cn: 第十一页的地图看起来十分奇怪。可是，把它上下倒转来看的话，就会变回你所熟悉的地图了。

en: Abraham Lincoln, the 16th president of the United States, was born in a log cabin in Kentucky.
cn: 美国的第十六任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯是在肯塔基州的一间木屋中出生的。

en: She is married to an English teacher, so she can take lessons free of charge.
cn: 她的老公是英文老师，所以她能免费上英文课。

en: At the beginning, I was bored with radio gymnastics, but now I do not dislike it.
cn: 我起初觉得广播体操很无聊，但是现在却喜欢上了。

en: Make a good translation of the sentence that you are translating. Don't let translations into other languages influence you.
cn: 请给您所译的句子一个良好的翻译。请勿让其他语言的翻译影响到您所做的翻译。

en: In short, it is because the 'plan.doc' file I attached in the previous email was infected with a virus.
cn: 简单来说，就是因为我附在上一封电邮的「plan.doc」档案被电脑病毒感染了。

en: I met your mother through Facebook. So, if Facebook didn't exist, neither would you, my little angel.
cn: 我是在 Facebook 认识你妈妈的。所以，如果没有 Facebook，你也不会在这个世界上了，我的小宝宝。

en: My brother was supposed to pick me up at the station, but I couldn't find him.
cn: 我的弟弟应该会来车站接我的，但是我却找不到他。

en: The number of students who were late for school was much smaller than I had expected.
cn: 上学迟到的学生人数比我想像中少很多。

en: The antiques my father left when he died turned out to be nothing but worthless junk.
cn: 父亲生前留下来的老古董，原来只是一堆不值钱的垃圾。

en: The more difficult the questions are, the less likely I'll be able to answer them.
cn: 问题愈难，我懂得回答的机会就愈低。

en: Put down your name on the list and pass it on to the next person.
cn: 把你的名字写在名单上，然后把名单传给下一个人。

en: It was a pleasure to spend the evening with a smart, funny and beautiful girl like you.
cn: 和你这样又聪明、又幽默、又漂亮的女孩共渡一晚，实在是一件赏心乐事。

en: I couldn't take my eyes off of you from the minute I entered this room.
cn: 从我走进这房间的那一刻开始，我的视线就不能再从你的身上移开了。

en: The hall was filled with such a large audience that there wasn't even standing room.
cn: 会堂里挤满了听众，连一点站立的空间也没有。

en: It is true Wendy grew up at the seaside, but she isn't a good swimmer.
cn: 温迪的确是在海边长大的，但是她却不太会游泳。

en: The weak point of this book is that it's less than persuasive when the married author recommends not being married.
cn: 这本书有一个弱点 ﹣ 作者自己结了婚，但却建议别人不要结婚，没有甚么说服力。

en: With respect to financial matters, Mr Jones knows more than anyone else in the company.
cn: 关于财务方面的事项，公司里没有人比琼斯先生更了解。

en: I'm actually relatively good at written language, but with spoken language I often can't remember the tone on some word.
cn: 其实，书面语我搞得相当好，但是口语中，我经常会记不起来某个字的音调。

en: At first many things seemed different, but I soon got involved in my new life.
cn: 一开始许多事情看上去不同了，但我很快习惯了我的新生活。

en: You should use words to make sentences, rather than try to learn them with rote memorisation.
cn: 你应该宁可用词汇来造句，也不要试着死记硬背。

en: The languages that have been transliterated within the Tatoeba Project are Japanese, Chinese, Shanghainese, Georgian and Uzbek.
cn: Tatoeba 计划获得了音译的语言为日语、汉语、上海话、格鲁吉亚语及乌兹别克语。

en: If you run into Mr. Long, don't forget to ask him about how his wife is doing.
cn: 如果你踫到朗先生，别忘了问候一下他的太太。

en: One hundred, two hundred, three hundred, four hundred, five hundred, six hundred, seven hundred, eight hundred, nine hundred, one thousand.
cn: 一百， 二百， 三百， 四百， 五百， 六百， 七百， 八百， 九百， 一千。

en: We've just received intelligence that the enemy is waiting in ambush two miles down the road.
cn: 我们刚刚收到情报，敌方正在前方两英里处埋伏。

en: The Indian flag is called the tricolour because it has stripes of three colours – saffron, white and green.
cn: 印度国旗叫做「三色旗」，因为它是由三条不同颜色的色条组成的 ﹣ 橙黄色、白色和绿色。

en: Going to church doesn't make you a Christian any more than standing in a garage makes you a car.
cn: 去教堂参加礼拜，不会马上就变成一个基督徒，就好像站在车房里，不会变成一辆车一样。

en: A passport is something you cannot do without when you go to a foreign country.
cn: 去外国旅行不能不带护照。

en: In the long run, we can save a lot of money by buying this machine.
cn: 长远来说，我们买了这台机器可以省回很多钱。

en: He found that the things he had studied in school were not useful in the business world.
cn: 他发现他上学学的东西，在商界根本派不上用场。

en: I was called into the office first, my name being at the head of the list.
cn: 我的名字在名单中排得最前，所以我第一个被叫进了办工室。

en: I'm just wondering how you are getting on and if you have adjusted to the new environment.
cn: 不知近况如何，你适应新环境了没有。

en: In the era of email, I'm so happy when a friend sends me a real letter.
cn: 在这个电邮的年代里，我一收到朋友寄给我的信，就会高兴得不得了。

en: I'd certainly like to go and watch the match; it's just that I'm not sure if I have time.
cn: 我倒是很想去看这场比赛，可是不知道有没有时间。

en: I haven't seen Xiaowang for a month now; perhaps he's already gone back to his own country.
cn: 我一个月没见到小王了，他说不定已经回国了。

en: Today I haven't dealt with the things I wanted to deal with; I'll have to work overtime again.
cn: 今天我要处理的事还没处理完，又要加班了。

en: This year, the speed of development in our company far exceeds that of last year.
cn: 今年我们公司的发展速度大大超过去年。

en: Our company's technology has already reached the level of a developed country in the 1990s.
cn: 我们公司的技术已经达到了发达国家九十年代的水平。

en: In China, children shorter than 1.1m don't need to buy a ticket to travel by train.
cn: 在中国，身高 1.1 米以下的儿童坐火车不用买票。

en: It is said that the price of wine may go up at any time now.
cn: 据说葡萄酒的价格可以随时增长。

en: The term 'greenhouse effect' is often used when people talk about global changes of climate nowadays.
cn: 人们谈到全球气候变化的时候，常常用到“温室效应”这个词。

en: It seems to be difficult for her to get along with students in the new school.
cn: 她和新学校的同学好像不怎么合得来。

en: His victory at this age in an international competition is a good indication of a bright future.
cn: 他现在这个年纪，就已经在国际比赛中取胜，前途实在无可限量。

en: No matter how good you are, there will always be people who are better than you.
cn: 不管你有多好,都还有人比你更好。

en: Although you can't make it as "the greatest person", you can still be the best person to your partner.
cn: 你虽然做 不到一个『最好的人』,可是你却做得到一个『对对方最好的人』。

en: They have both failed to find the most serious problem that has ever faced our planet.
cn: 他们俩都未能找到我们的星球所面临最严重的问题。

en: First of all, the level of the ocean could rise, because ocean water expands as it grows warmer.
cn: 首先，因为海水变热时膨胀，海平面可能提高。

en: It means a huge increase in the use of air conditioning which uses energy, which costs money and creates pollution.

cn: 在英国，以珍稀物种为主题的公园变得越来越受人们的欢迎。

cn: 一些大学生在假期去非洲做志愿者 ，帮助当地完善野生生物管理。

cn: 我们应该尽我们最大的努力减少塑料包装的使用，并回收所有的塑料废物。

cn: 从根本上说，十二生肖的形成，与动物崇拜有关。

cn: 以动物命名人的属相，是因为我们的先民与这些动物有密切关系。

cn: 生肖文化深深植根于人们的日常生活和语言文化中。

cn: 很多人都会问，为什么生肖的十二种动物里没有猫呢？

cn: 十二生肖里没有猫的原因很简单。

cn: 为了给他生日惊喜，我准备了一个非常棒的蛋糕。

cn: 否则，用左手传递食物会被认为是不礼貌的，因为左手是用来洗澡的。

cn: 例如，在保加利亚摇头表示同意而点头表示不同意。

cn: 在澳大利亚的快乐协会，两百块钱可能达到效果。

cn: 专家说只有百分之十五左右的快乐来自收入、资产等财政的因素。

cn: 高达百分之九十的快乐来自看法、生活控制、关系等因素。

cn: 研究表明人们一有住处、食物这些基本的需要，附加的财富就不能大量地提高他们的快乐。

cn: 这个旅馆的房间不像那个旅馆的房间那幺干净。

cn: 即使有人比你漂亮，也不会太多。

cn: “胡同”这个词，本意是“水井”，来源于700年前的蒙古语。

cn: 明代十五世纪初紫禁城是北京的中心。

en: Farther from the palace and to its north and south were the commoners, merchants, artisans, and laborers.
cn: 远离宫殿的北方及南方是平民、商人、工艺师傅和工人。

cn: 他们的四合院要小得多，设计和装饰也比较简单，胡同也比较窄。

en: Although the life of Chinese people is getting better and better now, there is still room for improvement.
cn: 尽管现在中国人的生活越来越好了，可是还有改进的余地。

en: Although it seems very difficult to study Chinese, it's not as hard as you think.
cn: 尽管中文学起来不容易，可是比你想的简单。

cn: 你怎幺敢指责我做这种事？我决不会动手打我的儿子。

cn: 请把发给你的那张单子看一下，再确认一下所有的句子都很通顺。

cn: 今天晚上我先用一下，争取明天还给你。

cn: 我现在身上没有那幺多钱，不过卡里有。

cn: 说明年夜饭的饺子是亲人团聚的象征。

en: In Chinese, 'dumpling' and 'first exchange' are homophones, so they have a rich cultural association.
cn: 在中文里面，饺子和“交子”谐音，因而具有丰富的文化涵义。

cn: 所有的思念与祝福都包进了那薄薄的饺子皮里。

cn: 我卖了房子和家具，连同我的手饰一起才凑了五十万。

en: If it's at all possible, I'd like you to take part in the next meeting.
cn: 如果可能的话, 我希望你参加下一次的会议。

cn: 凯特总是闹钟响了还在睡。说到这, 你今天看到她了吗？

en: I saw a red car and a white one. The red one was nicer looking than the white one.
cn: 我见到了两辆汽车：一辆红的和一辆白的。红的比白的好看。

en: How do you know they're not just giving you a weird look because you have a funny face?
cn: 你怎么知道他们奇怪的看着你不只是因为你有一张有趣的脸呢?

cn: 我不知道这份礼物应该给谁：给女孩子呢，还是给男孩子？

en: Among the five of us, he's surely the one who can speak the most languages.
cn: 我们五个之中，肯定是他说的语言最多。

en: I'm not a woman hater; and if I were, I would make an exception for you.
cn: 我不是一个厌恶女性的人; 但如果我是, 我会为你而破例。

cn: 如果你遇见Orleanu姊妹, 邀请他们去Ruxandra的庆生会。还有, 别忘了他们的兄弟。

en: Trams will link the area to Edinburgh's city centre (which is only two miles away).
cn: 电车会把这个地区连接于爱丁堡的城市中心（离那里只有两英里）。

en: Edinburgh already offers a busy and traditional city experience, with many historic buildings and tourist attractions.
cn: 爱丁堡已经供应一个繁忙而传统的城市，有许多历史性的建筑物和名胜。

en: The Waterfront project will help to keep Edinburgh up-to-date and bring more people to Scotland's capital city.
cn: 水边地工程会帮助爱丁堡城市紧随形势并使更多人来苏格兰的首都。

cn: 爱丁堡的水边地工程只是许多重建联合王国城镇的工程之一。

en: The panda is indigenous to Sichuan Province and does not live in the wild in any other places.
cn: 熊猫在四川省土生土长，不在任何其他省份的野外生活。

en: When the World Wildlife Fund was founded in 1961, it took the panda as its symbol.
cn: 国际野生动物基金在一九六一年创办的时候，以熊猫为象征。

cn: 中国福建省福州市动物园在训练大熊猫方面做得比它的同行多。

en: Country girls like to cut red paper into peach and plum blossoms and paste them onto doors and windows.
cn: 农村的女孩喜欢把红色的纸裁减成桃和李的花及贴在门窗上。

cn: 从那时起，在广州每年春节的时候都有花节。

cn: 用疑问代词表任指格式改写下面的句子，根据需要可以增加或者减少一些词语。

cn: 来自国家发展和改革委员会的数据显示，互联网在中国农村地区发展迅猛。

cn: 以前从来不知道永恒是为了什么。它是为了给我们一些机会学习德语。

cn: 如果你告诉他们富兰克林是第一个这么说的, 人们会更乐意接受你的想法。

cn: 在这个社会里一切都是用完即丢, 用东西直到它磨损是一种美德。

cn: 每天早上吃一只活青蛙, 那么你一天中其他的时间就不会发生什么更糟糕的事了。

cn: 如果我们应该少听多说话, 那么我们应该得到两个嘴巴一只耳朵才是。

cn: 我们胡闹太久了, 现在该是我们考虑基本事实的时候了。

cn: 奶酪是由母牛、山羊、绵羊或其它哺乳动物的奶加工制成的固体食物。

cn: 任何简单到可以被了解的宇宙便太过简单而无法产生可以了解它的心灵。

cn: 智者谈论想法, 知识分子谈论事实, 普通人谈论他吃什么。

cn: 有可能将电脑工作扩展到银行业务, 会计业务等等。

cn: 第一次，我差不多完全不会普通话，而且不懂中国的常规和传统。

cn: 我想要一支手机, 但是我没有足够的钱买一支。

cn: 多听不多言, 里外人不嫌。

cn: 这个工人本来应该在中午十二点到达, 但他被交通堵塞困住了几个小时。

cn: 如果你被困在一个荒岛上, 你会想要随身带着哪些书来看?

cn: 这是来自大阪中村先生的付费电话。你愿意付费吗?

cn: 想要跟你分享他们宗教信仰的人几乎从不愿你跟他们分享你的。

en: If you have hope, then you'll certainly find happiness, and will become a role model for others as well.
cn: 如果你怀抱希望, 那么你一定会找到幸福, 而且也会成为其他人的榜样。

en: I cannot forbid a person to marry several wives, for it does not contradict Scripture.
cn: 我不能禁止一个人娶好几个妻子，因为这与圣经不矛盾。

en: Even if we don't get lucky on the first try we can just keep fucking till I get pregnant.
cn: 即使我们第一次不够幸运, 我们可以就一直做爱直到我怀孕。

en: When you want to say "I promise", if you say "koko ni chikaimasu" you'll sound more like a native.
cn: 当你想说"我保证", 如果你说"koko ni chikaimasu", 你听起来会更象一个本地人。

en: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.
cn: 祂到自己的地方来，自己的人却不接受祂。

en: Hey! There's an American who speaks Uyghur here! Hurry up and get over here to inspect his computer!
cn: 喂！这里有个会说维语的美国人！快来把他的电脑检查一下！

en: The rescue workers are going to hand out supplies to the victims of the earthquake.
cn: 救助人员将为地震受灾者提供资助。

en: That's the thing about people who think they hate computers. What they really hate is lousy programmers.
cn: 那些自认为讨厌电脑的人就是这幺回事。他们真正讨厌的是差劲的程序员。

en: Every time I fall in love, Dad tells me the girl is my half sister.
cn: 每次我坠入爱河，爸爸就告诉我那个女孩是我同父异母的妹妹。

en: As this is a cascade with multiple layers, it shouldn't be surprising that it's slow.
cn: 因为这是一个有好几层的瀑布，所以速度慢也不会让人惊讶。

en: The old cottage had only one bed, so we all took turns sleeping in it.
cn: 那间旧屋里只有一张床，所以我们便轮流睡觉。

en: Newsflash: People a couple of hundred years ago didn't speak the same as we do.
cn: 新闻快报：数百多年前的人的说话方式和我们是不同的。

en: The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.
cn: 这次面试的意义是评断你适不适合这家公司。

en: As he has done a lot of bad things, we can conclude that he is a bad person.
cn: 因为他做了不少坏事，我们可以断定他不是个好人。

en: After looking at the research, most of us conclude that vaccines are a good thing.
cn: 看完研究以后，我们其中大部分人论定疫苗是件好事。

en: When I saw them on a date, I asked them, "Do I hear wedding bells?"
cn: 当我看见他们在约会，我问他们:"我听到婚礼的钟声了吗?"

en: Time is of the essence, Paul. If you don't tell her how you feel now, you'll never have another chance.
cn: 时间就是生命，保罗。如果你不告诉她你现在的感觉，你永远不会有第二次机会。

en: Despite Trang's constant affirmations of love, Spenser is still afraid someday she will fall out of love with him.
cn: 尽管庄不断发誓她不变的爱情，斯宾塞仍然害怕有一天她会不爱他了。

en: It was not until Lucy left me that I realized how much I loved her.
cn: 直到露西离开了我，我才意识到我是多么爱她。

en: The world is like a book, and those who don't travel read only one page.
cn: 世界就像一本书，不旅游的人只读了一页。

en: My mother used to pick me up every day when I was at primary school.
cn: 我读小学的时候，我母亲每天来接我。

en: I was having such a good time at the party that I didn't want to come home.
cn: 我在派对玩得太尽兴，以至于不想回家了。

en: Because we love you, we are updating Tatoeba to bring you a better user experience. See? We love you huh?
cn: 因为我们爱你，我们正在更新Tatoeba以便为您带来更好的用户体验。看吧？我们爱你吧？

en: The audio feature is only available in some sentences in Chinese, Dutch, French, German and Shanghainese.
cn: 音频功能仅适用在某些语言的句子中，如中文，荷兰语，法语，德语和上海话。

en: You have added a comment, not a translation. To add a translation, click on the "あ→а" icon above the sentence.
cn: 您已添加了评论，而不是一个翻译。要添加一个翻译，点击这句话上面的«あ→а»图标。

en: Johnny was a chemist; now Johnny is no more. For what he thought was water, was H2SO4.
cn: Johny以前是个化学家，但现在Johny不再是了。他以前所想的是水，是硫酸。

en: To fear love is to fear life, and those who fear life are already three parts dead.
cn: 惧怕爱就是惧怕生活，那些惧怕生活的人已经有四分之三部分死了。

en: To the man who only has a hammer in the toolkit, every problem looks like a nail.
cn: 对工具箱里只有一把榔头的人来说，所有的问题都像钉子。

en: Almost half the men in Great Britain regularly give chocolate to their partner, especially for their birthday.
cn: 大部分大不列颠的男人定期送巧克力作礼物给他们的合伙人，尤其是在他们生日的时候。

en: Obviously, this cannot be the work of one person. This is why Tatoeba is collaborative.
cn: 很明显，这不可能是一个人的工作。这就是为什幺Tatoeba是一个合作项目。

en: This book is intended for students who do not speak Japanese as a native language.
cn: 这本书是打算给不以日语为母语的学生所使用的。

en: Accordingly, besides noun declension patterns, there also existed a greater variety of verb conjugation patterns than in Modern English.
cn: 因此，除了名词的变格之外，也存在比现代英语多的动词的各种变型。

en: For the other 600 million people, English is either a second language or a foreign language.
cn: 对于其他的六亿人口而言，英语不是第二语言就是外语。

en: Maybe it's the low air pressure that means you get drunk more easily on planes.
cn: 也许这是低气压，这意味着你在飞机上更容易喝醉。

en: I think this lamp has a short because the light comes on only if I jiggle the cord.
cn: 我觉得这盏灯短路了，因为只有我摇线的时候灯才会亮。

en: I wonder if a day will come when money will be something found only in museums.
cn: 我想知道是不是会有一天钱会变成只有在博物馆才能找到的东西。

en: There's something I need to tell you, and I know you're not going to like it.
cn: 有些事我要跟你说，而且我知道你不会喜欢。

en: Since I installed solar panels on my house, my energy bill has been cut in half.
cn: 自从我在我的房子上装了太阳能电池板，我的电费单就减半了。

en: I was nine years old when I asked my mom if Santa Claus really existed.
cn: 我九岁的时候问我妈妈圣诞老人是否真的存在。

en: I've heard it said that English is for making money, French for making love, and Spanish for praying to God.
cn: 我听说英语是用来赚钱的，法语是用来做爱的，西班牙语是用来祈求上帝的。

en: This is a secret just between you and me, so don't let it slip out.
cn: 这只是你和我之间的秘密，所以不要让它流出去。

en: In order to improve the students' attitude to their studies, the school let them start class an hour later.
cn: 为了改进学生的学习态度，学校让他们晚一个小时来上课。

en: The novel "All Quiet on the Western Front" by Erich Maria Remarque has been translated into more than fifty languages.
cn: 埃里希马里亚雷马克所写的小说"西线无战事"已被翻译成超过五十种语言。

en: In the late 20th century, Yugoslavia was considered a rogue state by the United States.
cn: 在二十世纪末期，南斯拉夫被美国认为是一个流氓国家。

en: A guy I met in my physics class made a didgeridoo out of PVC pipe.
cn: 我在物理课遇到一个家伙用PVC管做了迪吉里杜管。

en: Trombones: it may be fun to go wild, but try not to blat the notes.
cn: 长号:狂野可能有趣，但尽量不要发出粗哑的音符。

en: Let's find sentences with new vocabulary on this topic, add them to the following list: _____; and translate them.
cn: 让我们找关于这一主题有新单字的句子，将其添加到下面的列表：_____;并翻译它们。

en: My dad gives me a weekly allowance that I use to buy comics and ice cream.
cn: 我爸爸每周给我零用钱，我会用来买漫画书和冰激凌。

en: Susan, I'm sorry if I led you on but the truth is that I'm just not interested.
cn: 苏珊，我很抱歉让你抱有希望，但事实是我就是不感兴趣。

en: Stories like Cinderella can be found in China, Japan and in every land of the world.
cn: 像灰姑娘这样的故事可以在中国、日本及世界任何国家都可以找到。

en: In Asian culture it's customary to take one's shoes off before entering a house or temple.
cn: 在亚洲文化里，习惯在进一个房子或一座寺庙前先脱鞋子。

en: I have to wear earplugs to drown out all the noise from the construction site next door.
cn: 我不得不戴耳塞来阻隔旁边建筑工地的所有噪音。

en: Many of our pioneers are still alive... but, alas, many of them aren't alive any more.
cn: 我们的先驱者中许多还活着...但是，唉，其中有许多已经死了。

en: What do you have to lose by asking her out on a date? A little pride maybe?
cn: 问她出去约会你有什么好输的? 也许一点点的骄傲?

en: She can't make up her mind whether to get a job or to go on to college.
cn: 她在找工作和读大学之间无法取舍。

en: Twenty-five years after Chernobyl, milk, mushrooms and berries are still contaminated in some parts of Ukraine.
cn: 在切尔诺贝利核电厂事故二十五年后，在乌克兰的某些地区，牛奶，蘑菇和浆果仍然受到了污染。

en: To err is human. To blame someone else for your mistakes is even more human.
cn: 是人都会犯错。为你自己的错误指责别人，更是人类会做的事。

en: Losing his balance from a sudden gust of wind, the tightrope walker fell to his death.
cn: 突然刮起一阵风，走钢索的人失去了平衡便摔死了。

en: In the U.S., you have the option, when you enter a restaurant, to sit in the smoking or non-smoking section.
cn: 在美国，当你进入餐厅时，你可选择坐在吸烟区或是禁烟区。

en: If you would agree to answer some of the questions below, I would be extremely grateful.
cn: 如果您同意回答下面几个问题，我就非常感激您的帮助。

en: Are there any aspects of Shanghai that are not as good as those of Beijing?
cn: 上海有什幺不如北京的方面吗？

en: In all of the gardens in my city it is illegal to trample the flower beds.
cn: 在我的城市的所有花园里，践踏花坛是违法的。

en: One out of 455 women doesn't realize she's pregnant until the twentieth week of pregnancy.
cn: 455名妇女中会有一名直到怀孕第二十周前没有意识到自己怀孕。

en: When using this information, I will follow any conditions you specify, whether that's anonymity or giving detailed reference.
cn: 在使用这份问卷的信息时，我会遵照您提出的条件，不留您的姓名或者关于您的任何详细信息。

en: One of the great mysteries of life is how a cat decides what to do next.
cn: 生活的伟大奥秘其中之一是猫如何决定下一步要做什么。

en: We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
cn: 我们说我们所知道的，为我们所看到的作证；你们却不接受我们的见证。

en: Only with wisdom can one distinguish between good and evil; only with humility can one build a happy life.
cn: 有智慧才能分辨善恶邪正；有谦虚才能建立美满人生。

en: The most beautiful thing in the sky are the stars, the most beautiful thing in life is kindness.
cn: 天上最美是星星，人生最美是温情。

en: Don't be afraid of having tigers for enemies; be afraid of having pigs for friends.
cn: 不怕虎一样的敌人，就怕猪一样的队友。

en: Do you really think that I will simply watch you walk into trouble? I'd close my eyes.
cn: 你以为我会眼睁睁地看着你去送死？我会闭上眼睛的。

en: Any problem that can be resolved with money isn't a problem, but the problem is that I'm poor.
cn: 能用钱解决的问题都不是问题，可问题是我是穷人。

en: What are you unhappy about? Let it out and let everyone cheer you up a bit.
cn: 你有什么不开心的事? 说出来让大家开心一下。

en: Don't argue with an idiot, or else people might not be sure which of you is really the idiot.
cn: 不要同一个傻瓜争辩、否则别人会搞不清到底谁是傻瓜。

en: If you’ve only slept for three hours, you certainly won’t do well in the exam.
cn: 如果你只睡了三个小时觉，一定会考试考得不好。

en: A writer is somebody for whom writing is more difficult than it is for other people.
cn: 作家是一个写作对他来说比对其他人更困难的人。

en: They have eyes but they do not see - ears, and they do not hear.
cn: 他们有眼睛，但看不见；有耳朵，但听不见。

en: She is popular not because she is beautiful, but because she is kind to everyone.
cn: 她受人欢迎，不是因为她漂亮，而是因为她人很好。

en: After the assistant returned $1 to each one, each man had actually paid only $9.
cn: 然后助手还给每人1美金，每个人实际上只付了9美金。

en: We celebrate November 28 as Tatoeba day because it is the day when Turkish, Esperanto and Greek were added.
cn: 我们将11月28日作为Tatoeba日来庆祝，因为土耳其语、世界语和希腊语是在那天被加上去的。

en: Now that we are at nearly the same level, we can start learning some piano duets.
cn: 现在我们差不多有同样的水平了，我们可以开始学习几段四手联弹。

en: What I have learnt is not just the Chinese language, but something about the country itself as well.
cn: 我学习的不只是中国的语言，也是一些关于这个国家的东西。

en: When I first came to Beijing, I loved to stroll everywhere, but Beijing was not like what I had imagined.
cn: 我先来北京时，就去哪里都爱逛街，可是北京跟我想象的不一样。

en: On seeing this, I can't help thinking: Can the residents of Beijing keep up with such a pace?
cn: 看到这个以后，我不得不想到：北京的居民能跟上那幺快的速度吗？

en: I have come to realize that China is developing quickly but the Chinese people live a relatively leisurely life.
cn: 我意识到虽然中国发展得很快，中国人还有比较悠闲的生活。

en: It is because light travels faster than sound that some people look brilliant before sounding stupid.
cn: 光速比音速快，所以某些人在开口前，看起来还挺聪明的。

en: Bob gave Tina almost all the stamps he had collected, and kept only a few for himself.
cn: 鲍勃几乎把他所收集的所有邮票给了缇娜，只留了一点给他自己。

en: All things considered, I think you should go back home and take care of your parents.
cn: 全盘考虑后，我觉得你应该回家，照顾你的父母。

en: Before welcoming a beautiful tomorrow, every rich man will ensure that he gets sufficient rest!
cn: 在迎接美好的明天前，每个富有的人一定会确保自己有充分地休息！

en: Shortly after the war my father bought a new house, in which I was born.
cn: 战后不久，我的父亲就买了一栋房子，而我就是在那栋房子里出生的。

en: Only in novels do you find individuals who live out their whole life with unvarying character.
cn: 只有小说人物才会有一辈子不改变的性格。

en: Rather than live a hundred years as a rabbit, live one day as a tiger.
cn: 宁可当只老虎活一天，也不愿当只兔子过一百年。

en: Christine stayed in the shade all day, because she didn't want to get a sunburn.
cn: Christine整天待在阴凉的地方，因为她不想被晒伤。

en: I was born into the Hebrew persuasion, but when I got older I converted to narcissism.
cn: 我天生具有希伯来人的说服才能，但当我年纪大了的时候，我把它转换成了自恋。

en: It is well known that up to the middle of the last century Japan was a feudal state.
cn: 众所周知，直到上个世纪中叶日本是一个封建国家。

en: When I was in London last year, someone broke into my room and stole my wallet.
cn: 当我去年在伦敦的时候，有人闯进了我的房间，偷走了我的钱包。

en: Not a few people think that all foreign-made articles are superior to ones made in this country.
cn: 不少人认为，所有外国制造的物品均优于那些在本国所制造的。

en: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
cn: 我们ACME有限公司，特此宣布，我们将尽我们的力量抵制这种恶意收购。

en: We're all human beings, so in my opinion each country's culture is 90% the same.
cn: 因为我们都是人类，所以我的观点是每个国家的文化其实百分之九十一样。

en: Although people like to focus on the differences, I think that on the whole it's the same.
cn: 虽然人们喜欢集中于不同的方面，但是我认为大部分的差不多。

en: I think that English people might be more used to language learners than people in other countries.
cn: 我觉得英国人可能比别的国家习惯跟语言学习者说话。

en: Of course, another explanation of this situation is that Chinese is harder to learn than English.
cn: 当然，对这个情况的另一个解释是中文比英文难学。

en: Every year, the organisation organises a number of meetings of volunteers who go door-to-door to sell Frisian books.
cn: 每年，这个机构组织很多会议的志工挨家挨户地卖弗里斯兰语书。

en: In nostalgic moments we may tend to think of childhood as a time of almost unbroken happiness.
cn: 在怀念旧日时光的时刻，我们可能往往想起童年像是有着几乎完整幸福的一段时期。

en: Those without knowledge can do nothing, and those who can do nothing can eat nothing.
cn: 没知识的无事干，没事干的无饭吃。

en: Did you know that if you plug a pickle into an electrical outlet, it glows and makes buzzing noises?
cn: 你知道如果你把泡菜插入电源插座，它会发光并且发出嗡嗡的声音吗？

en: Of these, Taoism is a native religion, the others having been introduced from foreign lands.
cn: 其中，道教是本国的，其他是从国外引进的。

en: Taoism was founded on the teachings of Laozi, a sage born in 604 B.C. in present-day Henan Province.
cn: 道教是用老子的教导创立的，他是公元前六零四年在现代的河南省出生的圣贤。

en: He and a colleague who went to China later translated The New Testament into Chinese.
cn: 他跟一个去中国的同事后来把圣经中的新约翻译成中文。

en: In my view, everyone should have intellectual hobbies as well as an interest in physical activities.
cn: 对我自己来说，每个人应该有学知识的爱好，也应该对体育活动感兴趣。

en: I also run my own website, to try and record my progress and to help other people a little bit.
cn: 我也管理自己的网站，试试记录我的进步而且给别人帮助。

en: Because it's a developing country, some aspects of China aren't as good as those in Western countries.
cn: 因为中国是个发展中的国家，所以有的方面没有西方国家那幺好。

en: Is this Arabic ? - No, this is Uighuric, a language spoken in North-West China.
cn: 「这是阿拉伯文吗？」「不是，这是维吾尔文，一种中国西北部的语言。」

en: Even if you're really going through hard times, a good friend can improve your spirits.
cn: 即使你受苦受难，一位好友还可以改进你的心情。

en: I have five sons. Two of them are engineers, another is a teacher and the others are students.
cn: 我有五个儿子。其中两个是工程师，另一个是老师，其余的是学生。

en: At lunchtime today, our usual restaurant was closed because of a funeral in the family.
cn: 今天午餐时间，我们常去的饭馆关门了，因为他们家在办丧事。

en: At first, we weren't familiar at all. Over time we got to know each other.
cn: 起初我们并不熟悉，渐渐地就熟悉起来了。

en: Having forgotten his key, he was able to open the door by inserting a wire in the keyhole.
cn: 他没带钥匙，用铁丝拨动了两下，门居然开了。

en: Women like men the way they like their coffee: strong and hot to keep them awake all night long.
cn: 女人喜欢男人的方式跟他们喜欢自己的咖啡一样：强，热，并且让她们整夜醒着。

en: If it's okay for him to buy a knife, then why on earth can't I?
cn: 他买一把刀行，我买就不行了吗？

en: Please don't be so surprised that I'm speaking this language and listen to the content of what I'm actually saying.
cn: 请不要惊讶我讲这种语言，请注意我讲的内容。

en: I had to attend two meetings yesterday, and there was no time to have lunch between.
cn: 我昨天要开两个会，连吃午饭的时间也没有。

en: Notice how the hero in an action flick never seems to run out of ammo?
cn: 你有没有发现动作片主角的子弹好像永远都不会用完？

en: What is important is not how many books you read, but what books you read.
cn: 最重要的不是你看了多少书，而是你看的是甚么书。

en: Russell was a brilliant philosopher, but even the simplest practical task was quite beyond him.
cn: 罗素是一个极出色的哲学家，可是他对日常生活中的事务却是一窍不通。

en: If we ever came in contact with an alien race, how would we communicate with it?
cn: 如果有天我们真的和外星人有了接触，我们应该怎样和他们沟通呢？

en: He does not, in short, write with the candor of a man who is completely confident of his thesis.
cn: 简单来说，他的文笔并没有流露出那种对自己的论文充满信心的人应有的直率和坦诚。

en: The demon grabbed my sister and, with howling laughter, cast her into a bottomless pit.
cn: 恶魔一把抓住了我的妹妹，一边狰狞地狂笑着，一边把她丢进了一个无底洞里。

en: A lady's imagination is very rapid; it jumps from admiration to love, from love to matrimony, in a moment.
cn: 女人的思维很有跳跃性：从仰慕到爱慕，从爱慕到结婚都是一眨眼间的事。

en: As you look at your face, you try to figure out what is happening behind it, in your mind.
cn: 当你看着自己的脸时，你会试图去发现这张脸后面的心灵里在发生着什幺。

en: Religion is regarded by the common people as true, by the wise as false, and by the rulers as useful.
cn: 宗教在一般人的眼中是真理，在智者的眼中是谎言，而在统治者的眼中则是一种工具。

en: There are many guesses about how language began, but the fact is that no one really knows.
cn: 人们对语言的起源作出过许多猜想，但是真实的情况其实根本没有人知道。

en: He is by nature a kind person and is popular with the children in his neighborhood.
cn: 他天生就是一个和蔼可亲的人，所以很受住在附近的孩子欢迎。

en: Investing money in your home has some merit; when it is time to sell it you can get more money.
cn: 多花点钱在房子上，也有一些好处 ﹣ 例如，卖的时候可以卖个比较好的价钱。

en: Instead, they detect sounds through their tongues and feel vibrations through sense organs in the skull.
cn: 相反，他们通过舌头来侦测声音，并通过头骨内的感觉器官来感受震动。

en: Exactly what method did you use to improve your Mandarin in such a short space of time?
cn: 你到底是用了什幺办法在短期内提高了你的汉语？

en: The application allows you to quickly calculate the ratio of body mass index - BMI.
cn: 这项应用程序能让你快速计算身高体重指数（BMI）。

en: BMI categories (underweight, overweight or obese) from general reading table are inappropriate for athletes, children, the elderly, and the infirm.
cn: 总读数表的身高体重指数分类（体重过轻、超重或肥胖）不适用于运动员、儿童、老人和体弱者。

en: To change the units from metric to imperial and vice versa, the 'menu' button must be clicked.
cn: 要把公制单位换算成英制或反过来操作，须点击“菜单”按钮。

en: Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, but today is a gift. That is why it is called the "present".
cn: 昨天是历史，明天是谜团，只有今天是天赐的礼物。那就是它为什么被称作「当下」的原因。

en: Where programmers use semi-colons every day, the majority of people only use them in emoticons.
cn: 尽管程序设计师天天都会用到分号，大多数人只把分号用在表情中。

en: Tom has gotten older and he doesn't go out as often as he used to.
cn: 汤姆已渐老去，不像从前那样常常出门了。

en: Compare it to other enjoyable activities: going to the cinema, reading books, going for walks, chatting to friends etc.
cn: 把它相较于其他有意思的活动：去电影院，看书，散步，跟朋友聊天等等。

en: There are plenty of examples of people who do these things “excessively”, but no-one says those are “addictions”.
cn: 做这些事做得太多的人的例子多的是，可是没有说是“瘾症”。

en: The concept of “Internet addiction” implies that “the Internet” is some sort of definable activity.
cn: “网络成瘾症”这个理念将意味着“网络”是一种可以下定义的活动。

en: They used the Internet too much because they had some underlying problem that also caused them to neglect their child.
cn: 他们是因为患有一种使他门忽视孩子的基础精神病而过于上网。

en: This is an example of confusing two things that have a common cause with one thing that causes another.
cn: 这显然是将属并列关系的两件事误解成为因果关系了。

en: She and I hold the same position in the company, but she earns more than I do.
cn: 我和她在公司里职位相同，但她赚的钱比我多。

en: I guess what I've said isn't all that clear, but that's the only way I can explain it.
cn: 总觉得解释的不是很清楚...但我只知道这样...

en: As I didn't have time to go shopping today, I had to make do with a sandwich for dinner.
cn: 因为今天我没法上街购物，只好做点三明治将就将就。

en: There on the top of a high mountain they built a small town of their own and lived in peace.
cn: 他们在高山顶上建了自己的小城镇在那里过着宁静的生活。

en: I am very much surprised to hear that he got badly injured in a motorcar accident.
cn: 他因车祸受了重伤的消息让我震惊万分。

en: The supermarkets are now closed, so we'll have to make do with what is left in the refrigerator.
cn: 超市现在已经关了，我们只能加减用一下冰箱里剩的食物。

en: There are many kinds of insurance such as: health insurance, fire insurance, life insurance, etc.
cn: 保险有很多种，例如健康保险、火灾保险、人寿保险等等。

en: He came back not because he was homesick, but because he was running short of money.
cn: 他不是因为想家，而是因为没钱才回来的。

en: A good book can completely absorb your attention, to the extent that you forget your surroundings and even your existence.
cn: 一本好书会令你全神贯注，甚至忘掉周围和自己。

en: When you are cheerful, books can increase your happiness; when you are sad, books can lessen your sorrow.
cn: 开心时，书可以给你增加快乐；忧伤时，书可以给你减少哀愁。

en: No matter what your main purpose is in reading, books should never fail to provide contentment and satisfaction.
cn: 无论读书的目的是什幺，书总会带给我们乐趣和满足。

en: Whether the characters in a book are real or completely imaginary, they can become your friends and companions.
cn: 无论书中的人物是真实的还是完全假想的，他们能成为你的伙伴和朋友。

en: By reading books we can walk with the great and the good from every place and every era.
cn: 在书中，我们可以跟各个时代、各个地方的智者仁人同行。

en: Our real life friends may sometimes bore us, but the friends we find in books would never do that.
cn: 我们生活中的朋友有时会让我们觉得无聊，而我们书中的朋友永远不会这样。

en: By turning the page, we can dismiss the characters in a book without fear of hurting their feelings.
cn: 书页翻动之间，我们可以对书中的人物不予理会而不伤及他们的情感。

en: When real life friends desert us, books are always ready to offer friendship, sympathy and motivation.
cn: 生活中的朋友弃我们不顾之时，书随时给我们送来友谊、同情和鼓励。

en: If you're not sweating when you do cardio, then you're not doing it hard enough.
cn: 如果你做带氧运动的时候没有流汗，那就代表你做得不够剧烈。

en: The basic job of an advertising agency is to figure out how to turn a desire into a need.
cn: 广告商最基本的工作就是把人的欲望转化成需要。

en: The amount of people on Facebook is greater than the population of the United States of America.
cn: Facebook用户数量超过美国人口。

en: Huizi asked Zhuangzi: "If you're not a fish, how do you know what fish enjoy?"
cn: 惠子问庄子：「子非鱼，安知鱼之乐？」

en: All happy families resemble each other, each unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.
cn: 幸福家庭的幸福原因全都大同小异，但悲惨的家庭却往往各自有各自的惨法。

en: My boss tried to cop a feel but I slapped his hand before he got any further.
cn: 我老板想占我便宜，我便一掌拍了在他的手上，让他不能再毛手毛脚。

en: The amount of time someone is willing to spend on something may communicate how important it is to him.
cn: 从一个人在某件事上肯花多少时间，就能看出这件事对这个人有多重要。

en: I can't quite figure out what that chord around 1:58 is. Can somebody help me out?
cn: 我听来听去也听不到一分五十八秒左右的那个和弦是甚么和弦，有人可以帮帮我吗？

en: Silvio Berlusconi is an Italian politician, the current Prime Minister of Italy, as well as a successful entrepreneur.
cn: 西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼除了是一位意大利政治家和现任的意大利总理，也是一个成功的商人。

en: It seems that the policeman in this TV series is a dirty cop who abuses his authority.
cn: 这套电视剧里的惊察似乎是个滥用职权的坏蛋。

en: In many cases, the image that comes to mind when you listen to music is that of the CD's artwork.
cn: 听歌时脑海里浮起的图像，许多时候都是唱片的封面。

en: We ought to buy some new office equipment: the stuff we've got is out of date.
cn: 我们现在的办公室用品都过时了，得去买点新的了。

en: No women like to wear a dress that another discarded. With men, they're not so choosy.
cn: 没有女人会喜欢穿二手裙子；可是二手男人呢，她们却照要不误。

en: It is such a nice thing to say that I felt the need to say it.
cn: 这是多好的一件事，以至于我不吐不快。

en: She has asked the person at the front desk to connect her to that number.
cn: 她请了前台的人为她打那个号码。

en: If you want to use Chinese characters, be sure you've saved your files in the UTF-8 encoding.
cn: 如果你想使用中文字符，你应该以UTF-8编码来保存你的文件。

cn: 公开此事会影响我们的销售，所以我们将忽略它一次。

cn: 露西也许能帮你的忙，如果你一人做不来十个人的晚饭。

en: It is generally accepted that a person cannot be successful in life without a lot of hard work.
cn: 人们普遍认为吃得苦中苦，方为人上人。

en: As the train came to a halt, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.
cn: 当列车停止时，所有的乘客都想知道发生了什幺。

en: She was asked to convince him to get his son or someone else to paint the house.
cn: 她被要求去说服他以让他或者他的儿子或者是别的人来粉刷屋子。

en: When watching TV, please ensure that the room is brightly lit and watch from a distance.
cn: 看电视的时候请确保屋子够亮，观看时保持距离。

en: For quantities of 20 or more, we can allow you a special discount of 10% on the prices quoted.
cn: 20个以上九折特惠。

en: That place's food is great, and their prices are good, but the fly in the ointment is their terrible location.
cn: 那家馆子物美价廉，美中不足的是他们糟糕的位置。

en: She was able to be ready early this morning, because she finished packing last night.
cn: 她昨晚已经收拾好行李，所以今天早上没费多少工夫就准备好出门。

en: Even though he explained to me over and over again the meaning of this poem, I still don't get it.
cn: 虽然他对我反复解释这首诗的意思，我还是不懂。

en: I feel restless when I have to wait too long for my friend to show up.
cn: 等朋友等太久时,会感到烦躁.

en: If I do not get the item this week, I will make a complaint to PayPal.
cn: 如果本周我收不到货，我就向paypal投诉。

en: I will post lots of pictures, so it will be like you were there with me.
cn: 我会给你寄很多照片，让你感觉就像我在那里陪你一样。

en: If a man had 11 sheep and all but 9 died, how many sheep would he have left?
cn: 如果一个人有11只羊，除了9只之外，其他全部死了，那幺他还剩下几只羊呢？

cn: 我正要上床的时候接到了他打来的电话。

en: If it looks like an apple and it tastes like an apple, it's probably an apple.
cn: 如果看起来像个苹果而且吃起来也像苹果的话，可能就是苹果。

en: While I was reading in bed last night, I fell asleep with the light on.
cn: 我昨晚在床上看书的时候点着灯就睡了。

en: I was thinking that I would go there by bicycle, but it began to rain.
cn: 刚想骑单车去，却下起雨了。

en: To hide the fact that she's a princess, she disguised herself as a boy and escaped the palace.
cn: 她为了掩饰自己公主的身份，女扮男装，逃出了皇宫。

en: Memorising the cards in a deck in order is certainly a difficult task, but manageable.
cn: 把一叠扑克牌的排列次序背熟，虽然绝不是一件易事，却也不是没有可能的。

en: He could be found at 6 o'clock every morning in the barn, milking the cows.
cn: 他每天早上六点都会在牲口棚给母牛挤牛奶。

en: He has impeccable manners, which means you can never be sure what he actually thinks!

cn: 我倒是很想去看电影，可是不确定有没有时间。

cn: 市政府想建设专门的自行车道。但是，很多司机反对这个主意。

en: A person is a bachelor if and only if that person is a marriageable man who has never married.
cn: 当且仅当一个人是个没有结婚并可以结婚的男人，那个人是个未娶。

cn: 这是因为你总是全身心处理每一件事情，没有让鸡毛蒜皮的问题分散了你的目标。

cn: 人要从狗猛酒酸的典故中吸取教训。

en: Optimism is like the lamp of hope. Pessimism [or negativity] is like a drug of sorrow.

en: A reward will be paid to anyone who brings back the money that he lost.
cn: 凡能将他遗失的钱寻回者可得到酬金。

cn: 喔，好像是有这么回事，你稍等，我查一查。

cn: 我的网球拍裂了，所以我把它拿去修了。

cn: 你出国的时候学一些当地的礼貌用语还是很有用的。

en: Computers are certainly playing an important role in our life, whether we like it or not.
cn: 无论我们是否喜欢电脑，它在我们的生活中始终起着重要的作用。

cn: 将要考虑的另一个重要因素是，目前的情况对我们有利。

cn: 现在有些幼儿园推行的是双语教学，小朋友们都能滴里嘟噜地说上几句英语。

cn: 小丁拿着一张照片问林老师：“您的这张照片是在北大图书馆照的吗？”

cn: 世海拿着一本中文语法书去王老师那儿问问题。

cn: 要想学好中文， 就应该多跟中国人交流.

cn: 没有甚么比看见动物被虐打更能惹起我的怒火。

cn: 知情者也说，剑桥公爵夫人对近十二个月的成就也感觉“满意”。

cn: 证实她顺利地过渡入皇室组织，有帮于消除这些焦虑。

cn: 他在钢琴面前坐了下来，勉勉强强地弹了一首生日歌。

cn: 彼得每星期都至少会和身在美国的父母谈一次电话。

cn: 但是CNN获悉，由于她丈夫的指导，凯萨琳感觉已经适应了新的生活。

cn: CNN纪录片当中探究皇室最新成员在适应的时候他们是如何支持她的。

cn: 知情者提到去年三月有人看到女王和凯萨琳笑着聊天。

cn: 允许他去游泳只有一个条件，他不能离其他的男孩儿太远。

cn: 他会再一次提醒人们，这不仅是他一个人的决定，也是很多其他人的决定。

cn: 一个牧羊人把他一身白雪的山羊赶进被遗弃的山洞躲避暴风雪。

cn: 你问我怎么想？……好吧，那我就把我的心底话说出来吧。

cn: 十年来，人们越来越强烈地意识到需要改变自己的饮食习惯。

cn: 我弟弟可能得了急性阑尾炎，要是这样他必须做个手术。

cn: 记者想写一篇文章，以便引起公众对那件事情的注意。

cn: 由于加拿大婚姻法的改变，所以很多美国同性恋者去了加拿大结婚。
