cn: 希望就是当整个世界都在说“不“的时候轻声地说“还有可能”。

en: Even though my friend was a vegetarian, I didn't tell him that the soup had some meat in it.
cn: 我的朋友是吃素的，可是我没有告诉他汤里有肉。

en: I would like to buy a present for my wife. I thought about a scarf.
cn: 我想给妻子买一件礼物。我打算买一条围巾。

en: Data compression algorithms can be classified in two categories: those with data loss and those without data loss.
cn: 压缩数据的算法能分为两种：一种会造成数据损失，另一种则不会。

en: I don't agree with the theory that one should learn Latin in order to better understand English.
cn: 有人说，要深入理解英语，就必须先学好拉丁语。我不同意这种说法。

en: The thing that left the biggest impression on me in China was the Chinese food.
cn: 中国让人印象最深的就是中国菜.

en: As long as you finish eating your food, then you can play with your friends.
cn: 只要你吃完你的饭就可以跟朋友玩。

en: Inside my backpack there are many colored pens, red ones, blue ones, green ones, etc.
cn: 我的书包里有很多彩色笔，红的，蓝的，绿的，等等。

en: The purpose of antitrust law is to stop the abusive influence of the market by big companies.
cn: 反垄断法律的目的是停止滥用市场影响力的大公司.

en: On the 25th, the Chinese government issued a white paper entitled "The Diaoyu Islands are China's Inherent Territory".
cn: 25日，中国政府发布《钓鱼岛是中国的固有领土》白皮书。

en: I know that downloading music from the internet without paying is wrong, but I do it anyway.
cn: 虽然我知道从网上免费下载音乐是不对的，但我还是照样下载。

en: I hope I will have a chance to see you next time I'm in New York.
cn: 希望下次我在纽约还可以有机会见到你。

en: It's not that I don't like your English, but for me it's important to use every opportunity to practise Russian.
cn: 并不是我不喜欢你的英语，只是对我而言，利用每一个可能的机会来练习俄语很重要。

en: Laws are like cobwebs, which may catch small flies, but let wasps and hornets break through.
cn: 法网就像蜘蛛网，网得住苍蝇蚊子，网不住豺狼老虎。

en: She has been ill for a long time and she is still too weak to get about.
cn: 她病了很久，现在还很虚弱，无法随意走动。

en: I'm sure it wouldn't be too hard to find out who hacked into our system.
cn: 要找出入侵我们系统的黑客，我相信不会太难。

en: Is there something you want to get off your chest? Come on, you can tell me.
cn: 你是不是有什幺心事？来，跟我说说吧。

en: I've noticed that having fun doesn't interfere at all with your studies. I just can't.
cn: 我发现你玩绝对不耽误学习。我就不行。

en: No matter what you do you must always do it to the best of your ability.
cn: 不管你做什么都要尽全力。

en: After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and brothers and his disciples.
cn: 这之后他与他的母亲、兄弟和门徒们一起去了迦百农。

en: Vesak is a Buddhist holiday which celebrates the birth, enlightenment and death of the Buddha.
cn: 卫塞节是佛教的一个节日，纪念佛陀的诞生、成道和涅槃。

en: Can it be that you don't have a bit of creativity, to the point of always inventing the same apology?
cn: 你是没创意到连每次道歉的说词都一成不变吗？

en: The average man fails not because he lacks ability, but because he lacks ability to concentrate.
cn: 通常人们失败并非能力不足，而是不够专注。

en: This is the first time I've ever lied to my father and I am ashamed of myself.
cn: 我很惭愧，这是我第一次对我爸说谎。

en: I don't really like Xiaomi phones, and I think that they're for losers. They're like knock-offs.
cn: 我似乎不太喜欢小米，我觉得小米是屌丝用的手机，就是个山寨机。

en: There are two major political parties in the United States: the conservative Republican Party, and the liberal Democratic Party.
cn: 美国有两大政党，一是较为保守的共和党，一是较为自由的民主党。

en: I am going to enquire at the service desk if there are any restaurants around here.
cn: 我要去柜台打听这里附近有没有餐厅。

en: I only missed one day of work because of a cold and my desk is piled high with papers.
cn: 我才感冒一天没来上班，桌上就堆满了文件。

en: The point we must clarify here is that the lines between amateur and professional in sport are beginning to disappear.
cn: 我们必须阐明这个观点，在运动项目上，业余选手和专业选手的界限开始消失了。

en: When his food supply ran short, he had to look for a new place to live.
cn: 他的食物供给不足的的时候，他不得不去找新的地方居住。

en: I was told to go not by boat but by plane, which advice I followed.
cn: 别人建议我坐飞机而不是坐船去，于是我选择了坐飞机。

en: In Japan, it rains quite a bit during our rainy season which is from mid-June until mid-July.
cn: 在日本，在我们的雨季常常下雨，雨季一般在六月中旬至七月中旬。

en: When you go to play at a friend's house, you need to be well behaved and obedient.
cn: 你去朋友家玩要守规矩，要听话。

en: When an Uyghur met a Belarusian, what language did the two speak to each other?
cn: 当维吾尔人遇到白俄罗斯人时，他们用什幺语言沟通？

en: Listening to the personal analysis about global economy made by people who watch only CCAV has always been kinda funny.
cn: 听那些只看CCAV的老百姓进行全球经济的个人分析一直是很有趣的。

en: My teacher taught me that you can take the square root of a negative number.
cn: 我的老师教我负数也可以开平方根。

en: A user should have freedom with respect to both hardware and software. An operating system should be open, not closed.
cn: 用户应该拥有硬件和软件的使用自由，操作系统应该是开放的，而不是封闭的。

en: According to one study, Amazon's sales go down by 1% for every 100-millisecond lag in its loading times.
cn: 有研究称，打开速度每慢100毫秒，Amazon 的销售额就下降1%。

en: Our teacher is someone who likes precision, and always demands precise answers of her students.
cn: 老师性喜精准——她总是要求精确的答案。

en: I wish everyone luck in the coming year, as well as success in their work and studies.
cn: 祝各位来年好运，学习事业成功。

en: Worries are like ghosts - those who aren't afraid of them can't suffer at their hands.
cn: 忧愁就像魔鬼：谁不怕它，它就不能伤害谁。

en: Her eyes shone with joy when she saw that her mother was not mad at her.
cn: 当她看到妈妈没在生她的气，她的双眼因为幸福而闪烁了。

en: Almost all the American TV series of the last few years were written by homosexuals.
cn: 这几年美剧的编剧几乎都是同性恋。

en: If you want to have an attractive personality, you need to have a good head on your shoulders.
cn: 要想有良好的人格魅力，必须要有聪慧的头脑。

en: I'm discussing something with my friends at the moment. Wait a bit and I'll get back to you.
cn: 我在和朋友谈事，等会和你联系。

en: As the trees crave tranquility in the ever-persistent wind, the child craves the care of its ever-absent parents.
cn: 树欲静而风不息，子欲养而亲不在！

en: There are four seasons in a year, and the one I like most is summer. How about you?
cn: 一年四季，我最喜欢夏天，你呢？

en: It's gotten late, so you better hurry up and sleep. You still need to go to work tomorrow.
cn: 已经很晚了，快睡觉吧，明天还要工作的。

en: There's a big difference between reading for pleasure and stimulation and reading for knowledge and education.
cn: 为享受和生命激活而读书，和为知识和教化而读书，是两码事。

en: You speak French very well. I wish I could speak it as well as you.
cn: 你的法语讲的很好。我希望可以讲的像你一样好。

en: Over the last hundred years, there have been twenty-seven recorded deaths from spider bites in Australia.
cn: 过去一百多年，澳大利亚共有二十七例蜘蛛咬人致死的记录。

en: Today may be April Fool's Day, but your prank went overboard. Seriously, I'm pretty angry!
cn: 虽然今天是愚人节，但是你的玩笑开得太过分了，我真的很生气！

en: I don't know when spring will come and when the flowers will bloom. It was still snowing this morning.
cn: 不知何时春暖花开， 今天早晨还下雪了。

en: I didn't have time to cook dinner tonight, so I went out and bought a box meal.
cn: 今天没有空做晚饭，所以我去买了盒饭。

en: By switching your lover from 3D to 2D, you may successfully reduce all social-interaction-related costs.
cn: 把恋人从3D换成2D可以有效地降低交际所需的费用。

en: Only when the Party Committee Secretary came in person to resolve it was this point of view dispelled entirely.
cn: 直到党委书记出面加以解释，才算打消了这种想法。

en: First acknowledge, then deny – one for and one against – and then you are in a powerful position.
cn: 先肯定后否定，一正一反，就分外有力量。

en: He’d heard this more than once, but once was once more than he could bear.
cn: 这些话，他听过不止一次，唯其不止一次，才忍无可忍。

en: The natural world is always much more complex than formulations in the lab or blueprints in the design office.
cn: 自然界从来都比试验室的配方或设计院的图纸里所反映的要复杂得多。

en: Whenever I get a large sum of money, I donate some of it to charity.
cn: 我一得到一大笔钱就捐一部分给慈善机构。

en: If I tell him, then it's as good as done. He'll definitely take care of it.
cn: 我只要告诉他就好了，他肯定会干得到。

en: I had thought that he was a man, but it turned out that he was a woman.
cn: 我以为他是男的，原来她是女的。

en: An expert is a person who has made all the mistakes that can be made in a very narrow field.
cn: 专家就是一个能够把所有的错误控制在最小范围内的人。

en: I wish I were what I was when I wished I were what I am.
cn: 我希望当我在想我希望我是谁的时候我就是谁。

en: I'm completely soaked from the rain. Can you drive over and pick me up right now?
cn: 我浑身都被雨水给淋湿了。你现在能不能开车来接我？

en: When he asked who had broken the window, all the boys put on an air of innocence.
cn: 当他问道是谁打碎了玻璃时，所有的男孩子们都装作一副无辜的样子。

en: We had thought that he was a hero, but he turned out to be a traitor.
cn: 我们以为他是一个英雄，原来是一个叛徒。

en: It's when you teach foreigners Chinese that you realize just how flawed your own Chinese is.
cn: 教外国人中文的时候才会发现自己中文有多差。

en: Regarding the question at hand, can I give you an answer in two days' time?
cn: 关于该问题的答复，我两天后再回答你可以吗？

en: Little Wang is on maternity leave. She won't be back to work for six months.
cn: 小王休产假了，半年内都不会来上班。

en: We will follow your demands and make the necessary corrections to those parts that need them.
cn: 我们会根据您提出的要求对不足之处作出相应的改正。

en: Regardless how many times I try to solve this nasty problem, I always end up failing.
cn: 对于这个棘手的问题，无论我尝试多少次，结果都会以失败告终。

en: If there's a better solution, then I'll notify you about it as soon as possible.
cn: 如果有什幺更好的解决方案，我一定第一时间通知您。

en: Thank you for taking some time out of your busy schedule to reply to my letter.
cn: 谢谢您在百忙之中抽出时间回复我的信件。

en: Her repertoire on the piano is not very large, but she has learned every piece by heart.
cn: 虽然在钢琴上她的造诣不是很深，但是她勤而好学。

en: Not being able to carry out payments on time can cause very large losses for the consumer.
cn: 不能按时交付货款的话会给客户带来很大损失。

en: Black people had to sit in the back of the bus, or stand if the back was full.
cn: 黑人不得不坐在公交车的后面，如果后面的座位满了则只能站在那里。

en: I'd love to be able to tell the lady who cuts my hair that I don’t like bangs.
cn: 我很想告诉给我理发的女士我不喜欢留刘海。

en: When we were going through security, I got pulled out of line for a pat-down.
cn: 当我们过安检的时候，我从队伍里被拉出来搜身。

en: Long story short, she’s on the No Fly List and we might have been followed here by drone.
cn: 长话短说，她上了禁飞名单，回来时还可能有一架无人飞机跟着我们。

en: There are 1,000 English words written down in this vocabulary book, and they all have to be memorized by July.
cn: 这本单词本子上记的1000个英语单词，七月份之前要全部背下来。

en: Are you trying to suggest that my emotional problems are no different than those of a stupid person?
cn: 你是说我的情绪问题跟那些白痴没什幺两样吗？

en: So it seems that cloud of odorless deadly gas had a silver lining after all.
cn: 只能说，致命煤气的雾团中，也定会有阳光的。

en: You can talk, but you need to listen to me, as well. I also have the right to speak.
cn: 你可以讲话，但也要听我说，我也有权发言。

en: If you want to go, then go. If you don't want to, then it's no big deal.
cn: 如果你想去，就去好了。如果你不想去，那也没什幺大不了的。

en: The wreckage of the ship was salvaged after it had gone to Davy Jones's locker.
cn: 船的残骸从海底被打捞上来。

en: While dreams cannot tell you what will happen to you in reality, they are able to convey your innermost thoughts.
cn: 梦虽然不会告诉你现实中将要发生什幺，却能告诉你内心的真实想法。

en: If you go to bed late again, tomorrow you'll wake up with shadows under your eyes.
cn: 再不早点睡觉，明天醒来就会有黑眼圈。

en: Every person in this community is like a cell in the immune system of a healthy human body.
cn: 这个团体内的每个人，像是一个健康的人体内免疫系统里的细胞。

en: We will never be able to return to the way things were in the past.
cn: 我们再也不能一起回到从前了。

en: I am afraid that if I take this new job, I won't succeed at it.
cn: 我很担心我作这份新工作就不会做得好。

en: She once proudly stated that she was going to lose 5 kilos of fat in a single month.
cn: 她曾经夸口说一个月之内要减掉5公斤赘肉。

en: Sometimes I find that I basically have no time to pay attention to irrelevant trivia.
cn: 有时候发现自己基本上没有时间顾及一些无关紧要的琐事。

en: From what I understand, those who watch Korean soap operas basically are women with nothing to do.
cn: 我了解的情况是看韩剧者基本上是一些无所事事的女人。

en: The hand has five fingers: the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger, and the pinky.
cn: 人的手有五个手指: 拇指、食指、中指、无名指和小指。

en: People are not remembered by the number of times they fail but for the number of times they succeed.
cn: 人们被记得不是因失败的次数，而是成功的次数。

en: He has not yet done his homework, so his teacher is beginning to worry about him.
cn: 他到现在还没做功课, 所以， 他的老师开始替他担心。

en: It was for a dead person rather than a living one that we were searching.
cn: 即使明天天寒地冻，路远马亡，我也要有对简单生活和梦想的追求。

en: Most students agree with the proposal and have made a list of arguments in favour of it.
cn: 大多数学生同意这个建议，并列出了他们同意的理由。

en: The outcome of the test shows that the system has already fulfilled all design requirements.
cn: 测试的结果显示，系统已经满足了所有设计要求。

en: Because of a flaw in the original design, our website is vulnerable to SQL injection attacks.
cn: 由于最初设计中的一个缺陷，我们的网站易受到SQL注入攻击。

en: Due to lack of manpower, we need more time than expected to handle this task.
cn: 由于人力不足，我们需要比预期更多的时间来承担这项任务。

en: As a result of the server breakdown, total PV of yesterday dropped by 30% compared with normal.
cn: 由于服务器故障，昨天的总PV与正常相比下降了30%。

en: In consequence of some badly coded functions, the system is unstable most of the time.
cn: 由于一些写得糟糕的函数，系统大多数情况下不稳定。

en: In consequence of a new agreement between two competitors, we need to readjust our strategies.
cn: 由于两个竞争对手的一项新协议，我们需要重新调整战略。

en: We have optimized the database indexing, and as a result, system efficiency has improved by 50%.
cn: 我们优化了数据库索引，结果系统效率提高了50%。

en: The calculation of the budget for next year is based on the costs this year.
cn: 明年预算的计算是基于今年的成本的。

en: In order to complete the development on schedule, we request that other unrelated tasks be delayed for the moment.
cn: 为了按期完成开发，我们请求暂时推迟其他不相关的任务。

en: In order to move the project along smoothly, we have revised the plan several times.
cn: 为了顺利推进项目，我们已经修订了几次计划。

en: This new project in Java doesn't concern me at all, because I'm a PHP developer.
cn: 这个新的Java项目完全与我无关，因为我是一个PHP程序员。

en: He is going to take charge of a project concerning the future of the company.
cn: 他将要负责一个关系公司前途的项目。

en: In conclusion, the next step is to decide what we should do for the next step.
cn: 总之，下一步是要决定我们下一步应该做什幺。

en: Since all tasks have been completed without delay, we are ready to start the next phase of development.
cn: 既然所有的任务都按时完成了，我们已经准备好开始下一阶段的开发了。

en: Testing has been delayed by two days. As a consequence, we need to reschedule the release date.
cn: 测试延迟了两天，因此，我们需要重新安排发布日期。

en: Although the accident has delayed progress by one month, we have managed to catch up with the schedule.
cn: 尽管事故使进度延迟了一个月，我们还是设法赶上了日程表。

en: With this upgrade, one obvious impact is that users will be obliged to reset their passwords.
cn: 这次升级的一个明显影响是用户会被强制重置密码。

en: Thanks to his great help, we were able to solve the problem in 30 minutes.
cn: 多亏他的大力帮助，我们在30分钟内解决了问题。

en: It is a basic quality of an employee to complete his tasks within a fixed time.
cn: 在限定时间内完成任务是一个职员的基本素质。

en: This problem was troubling us until last night when we found the cause and fixed it.
cn: 这个问题一直困扰着我们，直到昨晚我们找到了原因并修复了它。

en: Driver, you're driving in the opposite direction. I want to go east. Why are you driving west?
cn: 师傅，方向反了，我要去东边，你怎幺往西边开？

en: Did something happen between the two of you? Why hasn't he been coming to pick you up recently?
cn: 你们俩之间是不是出现了什幺问题？他怎幺最近都不来接你了？

en: Suddenly, he took out a ring, kneeled on the ground, and asked me to marry him.
cn: 突然，他拿出了一个戒指，跪在地上，向我求婚。

en: You ask me how deep my love is for you? The moon represents my heart.
cn: 你问我爱你有多深，月亮代表我的心。

en: I represent all of the students in the class when I thank you for the help that you've given us.
cn: 我代表全班同学谢谢你给我们的帮助。

en: She was really upset at the time. She cried in the dorm the entire day.
cn: 她当时很伤心，在宿舍哭了整整一天。

en: This moment will nap, you will have a dream; But this moment study,you will interpret a dream.
cn: 此刻打盹，你将做梦；而此刻学习，你将圆梦。

en: If you want something to be done right, sometimes you've just got to do it yourself.
cn: 如果你想做对一件事，有时候你得亲力亲为。

en: In China, the history began thirty years ago; we can't know what happened any farther back than thirty years.
cn: 在中国，历史以三十年为极限，我们不可能知道三十年以前的事。

en: It was the morning rush hour, and there were a lot of passing pedestrians and cars.
cn: 当时正是早高峰，来来往往的行人和车辆很多。

en: As everyone stood guard silently, someone ran to the corner of the street and called over a police officer.
cn: 默默守护中，有人跑到街头，叫来了协警。

en: Only two things are infinite, the universe and human stupidity, and I'm not sure about the former.
cn: 世界上只有两个东西是无限的，一为宇宙，一为人类的愚蠢，我所不能肯定的乃是前者。

en: Operation Yoav was a military operation carried out by Israel in its war for independence.
cn: 约阿夫行动是以色列独立战争中的一次作战行动。

en: I'm sorry, but the only thing I know how to say in this beautiful language is this sentence.
cn: 对不起，但是我只会用这种漂亮的语言说一句话而已。

en: When my grandmother was young, her body was very slim. Now in her old age she's grown plump.
cn: 我奶奶年轻的时候身材很苗条，现在年纪大了就发福了。

en: In order to alleviate employment pressures, the nation has established a series of relevant policies.
cn: 为了缓解就业压力，国家已经制定了一系列相关政策。

en: This kind of medicine can temporarily alleviate pain. If you need it, just take it.
cn: 这种药可以暂时缓解身体的疼痛，你需要的话就拿去吧。

en: His humor charmingly eased the embarrassing atmosphere at dinner time and made me breathe a sigh of relief.
cn: 他的幽默巧妙地缓解了晚餐时尴尬的气氛，让我松了一口气。

en: There are many regrets in a person's life. It's not possible to do everything well.
cn: 人生总有太多遗憾，不可能做到事事完美。

en: Every time I leave, I'm of full the regret that I haven't fully said goodbye.
cn: 我很遗憾每次离开的时候，都没有好好地道别。

en: The regrettable thing is that he didn't even play at his highest level in the finals.
cn: 令人遗憾的是，他并没有在决赛发挥他的最佳水平。

en: One needs to do their best in all things, and more importantly work within their abilities.
cn: 凡事要尽力而为，更要量力而行。

en: Don't exercise excessively; do it within your limits, otherwise it may have negative effects on your body.
cn: 不能过度运动，要量力而行，否则反而对身体造成负面影响。

en: One needs to buy a house that's within one's means, but one also needs to grasp an opportunity.
cn: 买房要量力而行，但也要把握时机。

en: Although the decision to implement this plan has already been made, the finer points still need to be planned out.
cn: 这个计划虽然已经决定实施了，但是具体细节还需要从长计议。

en: China is perhaps the only country in the world where the temperature is controlled by the government.
cn: 中国也许是世界上唯一一个由政府控制温度的国家。

en: The assistant referee held up his flag to show the referee that the ball was still in play.
cn: 助理裁判向主裁判举旗示意比赛继续。

en: Philip hates traveling for away games. He always gets really tired and never plays well.
cn: 菲利普不喜欢客场比赛，他总是容易感到很疲惫。

en: When the goalkeeper touched the ball, the referee awarded the other team a corner kick.
cn: 守门员用手碰到了球，裁判给了对方一个角球。

en: Ronaldo’s teammate passed the ball high to him. He jumped up and headed it into the goal.
cn: 罗纳尔多的队友传给他一个高球，他纵身一跳，头球进门。

en: Messi was very close to scoring a goal, but the referee blew his whistle to say that he was offside.
cn: 梅西差一点就进球了，但裁判吹哨说他越位。

en: The fans went silent as they nervously watched the penalty shootout between the two teams.
cn: 球迷们安静下来，绷紧神经，观看两支球队的点球大战。

en: Because it had been raining for a couple of days, the pitch was muddy and difficult to play on.
cn: 球队已经训练了几天，所以这个足球场有些泥泞，不太好用了。

en: Ronaldo shot the ball right into the back of the net to score the winning goal.
cn: 罗纳尔多一脚射门，打进制胜一球。

en: There was a lot of excitement in the stands as the fans cheered for their teams.
cn: 球迷们在为自己喜欢的球队欢呼，看台上总是一片热闹的景象。

en: Lionel Messi is one of the best strikers in the world. He has scored the most goals ever for Barcelona.
cn: 里奥· 梅西是世界上最杰出的前锋之一，他是巴塞罗那进球最多的球员。

en: When Sir Alex Ferguson saw that his players were getting tired, he always substituted them.
cn: 当亚历克斯·弗格森看到自己的球员劳累时，他总是叫替补上场。

en: Bale needs to be more careful when playing because he’s already been given one yellow card.
cn: 贝尔在踢球时需要更加小心，因为他已经得了一次黄牌了。

en: Because all of the teams in the Premier League are really strong, the goal difference is usually small.
cn: 因为在甲级联赛中，所有队伍都很有实力，净胜球差异很小。

en: In the last World Cup, New Zealand was knocked out of the competition by Mexico.
cn: 在上一届世界杯上，新西兰在比赛中被墨西哥淘汰。

en: At the end of the first half Real Madrid were in the lead, but Chelsea won in the end.
cn: 皇家马德里在上半场处于领先，但切尔西最终赢得了比赛。

en: The referee, according to principle of advantage, raised his hand and motioned for the advance to continue.
cn: 裁判根据有利原则，举起手示意继续进攻。

en: Ronaldo is famous for his bicycle kick. When he does it, the fans go crazy.
cn: 罗纳尔多以他的倒勾球而闻名。当他展示倒勾球的时候，球迷们都沸腾了。

en: Jonathan was booked because he got into a fight with a player on the other team.
cn: 乔纳森吃牌了，因为与对方球员打架。

en: The opposition formed a line in the box to try and block Messi from scoring.
cn: 对方球员在禁区内组成一道防线，试图阻截梅西的射门。

en: The players sat and listened to their coach give them a pep talk in the changing rooms.
cn: 球员们坐在更衣室，听教练给他们打气。

en: Ronaldo is a prolific goal scorer and it’s almost guaranteed that he will score a goal in every match.
cn: 罗纳尔多是一个多产射手，基本上他能在每一场比赛中进球。

en: Atletico Madrid surprised everyone with their win against Barcelona as they’ve always been the underdogs in the Spanish league.
cn: 每个人都很惊讶马德里竞技会战胜巴塞罗那，因为他们在西班牙联赛中总是失败者。

en: Peter’s one of the best goalkeepers ever. He’s always able to pull off great saves.
cn: 波特是最棒的守门员之一。他常常可以有世界级的扑救。

en: You can't judge a person by appearance, just as you can't measure the sea with a pint pot.
cn: 人不可貌相，海水不可斗量。

en: It was lucky I was able to speak to Tom before he left for Boston.
cn: 在汤姆前往波士顿之前，我能和他说话可真算是走了运。

en: On a hot summer day, the air conditioner works all day to keep us cool.
cn: 炎炎夏日，空调全天开放让我们保持凉爽。

en: Some people clung to tree branches for several hours to avoid being washed away by the floodwaters.
cn: 为了不被洪水冲走，有的人紧紧地抱着树干长达数个钟头。

en: Nothing lasts forever, not for a long time, anyone can find an excuse to go ahead.
cn: 没有什幺永远，没有什幺很久，找个借口谁都可以先走。

en: I usually work from 9 AM to 5 PM, but today I worked until 10 PM.
cn: 我通常从上午九点工作到下午五点，但是今天晚上我十点才下班。

en: We can't choose where we come from, but we can choose where we go from there.
cn: 我们不能选择从哪里来，却能选择往哪里去。

en: We haven't contacted each other for quite a while. I am very happy to write to you.
cn: 我们好久没有联系了，很高兴能给你写信。

en: I've had a scratchy throat since this morning. I wonder if I've caught a cold.
cn: 早上起来，嗓子变得很沙哑，我想是不是感冒了。

en: Tom was exposed to a wide variety of music as a child through his mother's vast record collection.
cn: 由于母亲收藏了一整屋的唱片，汤姆小时候便有机会接触各种类型的音乐。

en: If you want to know what beauty is, go out into the wild; there you will find beauty.
cn: 如果你想知道什幺是美，请出门，走进自然，在那里你会发现美。

en: Unfortunately, my neighbor was involved in a traffic accident, and is currently in a coma.
cn: 很不幸地，我得邻居被卷入交通事故，呈现昏迷状态。

en: The future belongs to the few among us who are still willing to get their hands dirty.
cn: 未来属于我们当中那些仍然愿意弄脏自己双手的少数人。

en: What do you think was the most read article this year on the Japanese version of Wikipedia?
cn: 你认为今年在维基百科上被最多人阅读的日文版本的文章是哪篇？

en: The large crowd roared in approval as Mark Knopfler played the first few bars of "Money for Nothing".
cn: 就像马克·诺弗勒早期演唱的歌曲《金钱无用》一样，绝大多数的人依然高呼赞成“金钱无用论”。

en: Since the orbits are elliptical, the planets do not always have the same distance from the Sun.
cn: 由于轨道是椭圆形的，行星和太阳之间的距离不会总是相同。

en: People from the so-called first world look at us Latinos as if we hadn't invented the wheel yet.
cn: 所谓的先进国家经常把拉丁美洲人看成石器时代的原始人。

en: It is a great joy to see your own sentences translated into a multitude of other languages.
cn: 看到你自己的句子被翻译成多种语言是一件很开心的事情。

en: It was once very peaceful there, but now you'll sometimes hear the sound of passing vehicles.
cn: 那儿曾经很宁静，只不过偶尔会有一些过往车辆的声音。

en: If you marry a chicken, follow the chicken; if you marry a dog, follow the dog.
cn: 嫁鸡随鸡嫁狗随狗。

en: The five yuan coins are brass, and the ten yuan coins are made out of bronze.
cn: 5元硬币是黄铜做的，10元硬币是青铜做的。

en: Yesterday my big brother went to Fukushima to help the locals. I'm very afraid of the rise in radiation levels.
cn: 昨天哥哥去福岛给当地居民帮忙了。我对放射量的增加很害怕。

en: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.
cn: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。

en: It doesn't matter whether you have money or not. I love you just the same.
cn: 不论你有没有钱，我都爱你。

en: If the lion is the king of beasts, the eagle is the king of birds.
cn: 狮子是兽类之王的话，鹰就是鸟类之王。

en: I don't have a lot of work, but it's enough to keep me in the office this week.
cn: 其实我工作并不多，但足以让我这周在办公室里忙着了。

en: Because I was afraid of hurting his feelings, I didn't tell him the complete truth.
cn: 因为我怕会伤害他的感情，所以我没有把真相告诉他。

en: There still aren't any highways in this mountain region. All goods are transported on the backs of people and horses.
cn: 那多山地区还没有高速路。所有货运被驮在人的背上或在马的背上。

en: Other people can think what they want, as long as they think like I do.
cn: 别人可以随便怎幺想，只要他们的想法与我的相同。

en: In this kind of weather it's best if I stay at home and don't go outside.
cn: 在这种天气下，我最好是待在家里而不要出去。

en: Gao Dao is usually really suave, but he seems completely smitten in front of his girlfriend.
cn: 高岛平时虽然一副很帅气的样子，但是在他女友面前却是一副神魂颠倒的样子。

en: I feel that I am a burden to everyone, that no one will ever love me.
cn: 感觉自己对别人而言就是个累赘，不会有人爱上我的。

en: Let's just rest here for a little while, my feet are aching so much I can't walk.
cn: 我们要不在这里一下吧。我的脚好痛走不动了。

en: The others are leaving. What do you say we wait for them to go away and talk for a while?
cn: 其他人正在离开呢，要不要等他们走完了我们聊聊？

en: We love our mother almost without knowing it, without feeling it, as it is as natural as to live.
cn: 我们爱自己的母亲，几乎不无从知晓，无从感受，就像是活着的本能。

en: At what age will I be able to withstand what now hurts me so easily, makes me disheartened and anxious?
cn: 到了多少岁之后 ，我才能变得不会轻易地被某些东西伤害， 沮丧 ，旁徨失措呢。

en: I'm not a child, but sometimes you talk to me as if I were a child.
cn: 我不是小孩子，但有时你跟我说话就好像我是小孩子一样。

en: Tom is the head of the company in name only. His son makes all the important decisions.
cn: 汤姆名义上市公司的领导。他儿子做所有重大决策。

en: London is such a large city that visitors must use buses and the underground railway to get about.
cn: 伦敦是个大城市，游客必须乘公交或地铁才能出行。

en: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.
cn: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。

en: Life is like a marathon, where short-term gains and losses are not significant in and of themselves.
cn: 人生是一次长跑，暂时的落后和领先都不算什幺。

en: One of the reasons that we love nature is that, unlike ourselves, nature is not envious or deceitful.
cn: 我们之所以爱自然——其原由之一，至少是由于它不像我们人那样既嫉妒又欺骗。

en: Great! Is the apartment bought as a concrete shell, or is it ready to move into?
cn: 太棒了！是毛坯房还是装修房？

en: Tom was stealing money for the last two years, and Mary knew it all the time.
cn: 过去两年以来汤姆都在偷钱，而且这段时间里玛莉都知道。

en: Can I go out today wearing this shirt that has a little bit of red?
cn: 今天穿了这件有点儿红的衬衫，我能走出去吗？

en: A woman brought an old picture of her dead husband, wearing a hat, to the photographer.
cn: 一位妇女带了一张旧照片给摄影师，照片上是她过世的丈夫，她的丈夫戴着一顶帽子。

en: I had to change clothes because what I was wearing wasn't appropriate for the situation.
cn: 我必须要换衣服，因为我现在穿的衣服不适合这个环境。

en: I've just spoken to your French teacher and he says you're doing well in his class.
cn: 我刚跟你的法语老师谈过话，他说你在课堂上表现得很好。

en: My mother speaks French better than my father speaks English, so they usually speak to each other in French.
cn: 我母亲的法语比我父亲的英语要好，所以他们通常用法语交流。

en: My parents usually speak to each other in French, even though my mother is a native English speaker.
cn: 我父母通常用法语对话，即使我母亲的母语是英语。

en: This deal is mine, so you need to just settle down and agree with me.
cn: 这笔交易是我的，所以你需要去冷静并且同意我

en: Alrighty kids! So for this art project, all of you guys will split into groups of 3 - 5 people.
cn: 好了孩子们！所以为了这个美术计划，你们所有人都将被分离并加入3-5人的小组

en: We're sorry, Ami, but you can't be part of our group because it would... you know... exceed the 5-people-per-group limit.
cn: 我们很抱歉，Ami，但是你不能加入我们的小组因为..你知道的...小组成员不能超过五个人。

en: Everyone here already seems to be with a partner... what am I going to do?
cn: 这里的所有人似乎都已经和伙伴在一起了...那我接下来应该怎幺做？

en: The truth and simplicity of nature is always the most important foundation of noteworthy art.
cn: 大自然的真实和质朴往往是值得注意的艺术中最重要的基石。

en: Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
cn: Mary试图把围裙围在腰上，然后把烤鸡从炉子里拿出来。

en: On some OS's you get gibberish for filenames with full-width characters so when downloading please change to a suitable filename.
cn: 一些操作系统上有全角字符的文件名会显示为乱码，所以下载时请改成适当的文件名。

en: He recounted the accident to me as if he had seen it with his own eyes.
cn: 他讲起那场事故，讲得仿佛他亲眼所见。

en: We tend to think that our time is our own only on Sundays and holidays.
cn: 我们通常以为只有在星期日和假期，时间才属于我们自己。

en: Wood may remain ten years in the water, but it will never become a crocodile.
cn: 木头或许能在水里呆上十年，但它终究不可能变成一条鳄鱼。

en: When a woman is talking to you, listen to what she says with her eyes.
cn: 当一位女性在和你说话，要看着她的眼睛来聆听她的话。

en: Is there any difference whether I clean my room today, tomorrow, or the day after tomorrow?
cn: 我今天、明天还是后天清理我的房间有什幺不同吗？

en: Tom's mother is a nurse at the hospital that's across the street from where Mary lives.
cn: 汤姆的妈妈是一名护士，她所在的医院就在玛丽住的那条街的对面。

en: Tom tried to return the swimsuit for a larger size, but the clerk told him that wasn't allowed.
cn: 汤姆试过还回泳衣来换成更大一号的，但是员工告诉他那是不被允许的。

en: Tom asked me to tell you he didn't plan on going to Boston with you.
cn: 汤姆让我告诉你他没有计划和你一起去波士顿。

en: I just want you to give me back that book you borrowed a few days ago.
cn: 我只是想要你把我前些日子借给你的书还回来。

en: The best wealth is knowledge, average wealth is children, and the smallest wealth is material objects.
cn: 最好的财富是知识，一般的财富是孩子，最小的财富是物质。

en: I plan to accept the offer from that company to become their marketing department's manager.
cn: 我打算去应聘那个公司的营销部经理职位.

en: The objectives of the marketing department and the sales department are not necessarily the same.
cn: 销售部门和营销部门的目标不见得一样。

en: My Chinese is far from perfect, but I can roughly understand everything he is saying.
cn: 我的汉语并不完美，但能大致听懂他所说的。

en: Ah, I forgot to ask. Before you said you hadn't seen the umbrella. Have you found it since?
cn: 对了，前些时间你说伞不见了，现在找到了吗？

en: A bar in Shanghai started selling my favorite beer, so I'll take the opportunity to taste some.
cn: 在上海一家酒吧开始售我最喜欢的啤酒，所以我趁这个机会好好品尝。

en: We know very well where our developments will take us. Besides, in the team, everyone does as he pleases.
cn: 我们都清楚地知道我们的发展走向，另外，团队中每个人都有点随心所欲。

en: If one day you realised that you are good for nothing, what will you do?
cn: 如果某天你发现你一无所长你会怎幺办？

en: At first there will be many unrecognized words and grammatical forms, but don't be scared.
cn: 一开始会有很多不认识的单词和语法形式，但是不要害怕。

en: If you study new words, then use them more so that you will be able to more quickly memorize them.
cn: 如果你学习了新的单词，就多多去用它们，这样能够更快地帮你记住它们。

en: I can understand most of what they say, but I don't understand the slang they use (in their speech).
cn: 我大部分能听懂他们说的话，但是听不懂他们说的俗语。

en: In the London underground there is a warning to "mind the gap" when boarding the train.
cn: 在伦敦地铁，上车时会有「注意间隙」提醒。

en: In London, the police are always worried about finding a bomb on the train or subway.
cn: 在伦敦，警察总是担心在列车或地铁上发现炸弹。

en: I know a lot of French words, but it's difficult for me to combine them into sentences.
cn: 我知道很多法语词汇但我很难将它们组成句子

en: Nothing in the world is worth having or worth doing unless it means effort, pain, difficulty.
cn: 世间没有一种具有真正价值的东西，可以不 经过艰苦辛勤的劳动而能够得到的。

en: The number of people on Facebook is greater than the population of the United States.
cn: Facebook的用户比美国人口还多。

en: Tom has been on the dole since the 6th of August when he lost his job.
cn: Tom从八月六号他失业那天，开始领失业救济金。

en: She's what you call a "delinquent mom," but she's good at cooking, and most importantly, she's a really caring parent.
cn: 她就是你所谓的「年轻妈妈」，但是她的厨艺不错，最重要的是，她非常关心孩子。

en: Yesterday I became a god, but found that a bit boring, so today I became a devil.
cn: 昨天我变成了神，但没意思，所以今天我变成了鬼。

en: Last year in the Philippines, earthquakes and tidal waves resulted in the deaths of more than 6,000 people.
cn: 菲律宾去年地震和海啸造成了超过6000人的死亡。

en: Ladies and gentlemen, due to an accident at the airport, our arrival will be delayed.
cn: 女士们，先生们，由于机场的意外情况，我们的着陆将被推迟。

en: Be not afraid of life. Believe that life is worth living, and your belief will help create the fact.
cn: 不要害怕活着。要相信生命是有价值的，你的信念会使之成真。

en: I have a son and a daughter. My son lives in New York, and my daughter lives in London.
cn: 我有一个儿子和一个女儿。我儿子住在纽约，我女儿住在伦敦。

en: Going to bed early and waking up early is very good both for your health and appearance.
cn: 早睡早起对你的健康和容貌都很有好处。

en: Why don't we stop arguing over these piddling matters and get to the issues at hand?
cn: 为什么我们纠缠细枝末节而不进入正题呢？

en: Today, I was supposed to study at the library but I woke up around 12 o'clock.
cn: 今天我本打算在图书馆学习，但到12点左右才醒。

en: Tom came to the conclusion that no matter what he did, Mary wouldn't like it.
cn: 汤姆得出无论他做什幺，玛丽都不会喜欢的结论。

en: On the day of my birthday, my friends made me drink and I caused quite an uproar.
cn: 在我生日那天，朋友让我喝酒，我大闹一番。

en: If you pass the exam, how about we go to the bar to drink beer?
cn: 你如果通过考试，我们一起去酒吧喝啤酒，好不好？

en: Whether you pass the Chinese exam or not, let's go to the bar to drink beer.
cn: 不管你有没有通过中文考试，我们一起去酒吧喝啤酒。

en: I've never lived on a farm, but both of my parents grew up on farms.
cn: 我从没有在农场住，但我的父母都在农场长大。

en: His paralysis is progressing, and soon he won't be able to get out of bed.
cn: 他的瘫痪正在恶化，不久他就不能下床了。

en: After all, this is a guy that tried to kill my dad at one time.
cn: 毕竟，这家伙有一次想杀我爸。

en: I will probably be given a car by my dad and I would feel happy about it if that happened.
cn: 我爸爸可能会给我一辆车。要是真给就太好了。

en: Rio de Janeiro is perfectly safe as long as you stay out of the dangerous areas.
cn: 只要你远离危险区域，里约热内卢就是完全安全的。

en: Vikings 1 and 2 became the first space probes to successfully land on the surface of Mars.
cn: 维京1号和2号成为了最先在火星表面成功着陆的空间探测器。

en: My writing desk, a place of dread: an incredible number of incredibly useful drawers - combined with incredibly little legspace.
cn: 我的书桌很吓人：那么多那么有用抽屉，放在那么小、刚够伸腿的地方。

en: It's hard to believe that Tom wasn't aware that Mary was in love with him.
cn: 真难相信汤姆不知道玛丽爱他。

en: When we started out, our band could only find small clubs in small cities that would hire us.
cn: 我们的乐队刚起步时，只有小城市里的小俱乐部雇我们。

en: A friend of mine commissioned a well-known artist to paint a portrait of his wife.
cn: 我的一个朋友请了个著名画家给妻子画肖像。

en: I don't know if you know or not, but here in America you're expected to tip the waiter.
cn: 我不知你是否知道，但在美国你要给服务员付小费。

en: What are you going to do when the one you love does not love you.
cn: 当你爱的人不爱你怎幺办？

en: Recently someone told me about a language website, tatoeba.org, which I will definitely check out.
cn: 最近有人告诉我一个语言网站，tatoeba.org。我一定要看看。

en: Tom did the best he could, but he wasn't able to get a higher grade than Mary.
cn: 汤姆尽了全力，但他还是不能获得比玛丽更高的等级。

en: All Sadako could do now was to make paper cranes and hope for a miracle.
cn: 今祯子当时能做的就是折纸鹤并期盼奇迹。

en: The media has only discussed one thing in the last few months; the economic crisis.
cn: 媒体近几个月只讨论一件事：经济危机。

en: There are millions of people all over the world who are watching the World Cup right now.
cn: 现在全世界有数以百万计的人看世界杯。

en: Even though I studied English for 6 years in school, I'm not good at speaking it.
cn: 尽管我在学校学了6年英语，我还是说不好。

en: I'm running a little short on time, so I can only go out and buy flat bread and bread sticks.
cn: 我时间有点来不及，只能出门买大饼油条。

en: I could eat some beef noodle soup, or some reheated rice with soybean paste like that, no problem.
cn: 我可以不慌不忙吃牛奶面包鸡蛋，或者泡饭酱菜。

en: You can only make local calls from the room; you can go to the front desk to call long-distance.
cn: 在房间里只能拨市内，长途可以到总台来打。

en: It's just that because he hasn't made something of himself, his father won't look at him.
cn: 就是因为他不成材他爸看不起他。

en: If a person doesn't have a strong will, he will be unable to embrace profound wisdom.
cn: 如果一个人没有坚强的意志，那幺他也不会拥有高深的智慧。

en: A lot of people ask me whether bidding goodbye to youth means old age is near.
cn: 很多人问我，青春的诀别是否意味着年迈的将近。

en: But the butcher is observing the holiday today, there's nothing we can do about it.
cn: 可是肉店今天公休没办法。

en: There's a movie theatre on the east side of the plaza, about ten minutes walk from here.
cn: 广场东边有一家电影院，从这儿到大概要走十分钟。

en: In order to cut down on costs, the company refuses to allow employees to work overtime.
cn: 公司为了削减成本，拒绝让员工自行加班。

en: If you make fun of our company again, we certainly won’t be polite to you.
cn: 你要是再给我们公司出洋相，我可就不客气了。

en: Surely he can not enter a second time into his mother's womb to be born!
cn: 他当然不可能回到娘胎里再出生一次了！

en: Tomorrow's weather won't be so good, with cloudy skies, heavy snow, and very cold temperatures.
cn: 明天天气不好，不是晴天，要下雪，很冷。

en: How many times a week do you go to the movie theater to watch movies?
cn: 你一般星期几去电影院看电影？

en: Europe, with its four distinct seasons, is the most suitable environment for the human race to live in.
cn: 欧洲四季分明，是最适合人类居住的地区。

en: Because we only have one earth, we need to understand more how to care for it.
cn: 我们因为只有一个地球，所以更要懂得爱护它。

en: Do you want Catalonia to become an independent state in the form of a republic?
cn: 你希望加泰罗尼亚成为共和国形式的独立国家吗?

en: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
cn: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。

en: Should the United Kingdom remain a member of the European Union or leave the European Union?
cn: 英国应当留在还是脱离欧盟?

en: Learn from the mistakes of others. You can never live long enough to make them all yourself.
cn: 从别人的错误中学习，因为你无法所有事都亲身经历一次。

en: As the moon rises above the sea, we share the same time though we are far apart.
cn: 海上升明月，天涯共此时。

en: Sometimes, I wish I could walk through time, and meet myself back when I was still a child.
cn: 有时候，真希望自己可以适时的穿越回去，去见见那个还是个小孩子的自己。

en: In the end, we will remember not the words of our enemies, but the silence of our friends.
cn: 到头来，我们记得的不是敌人的话语，而是朋友的沉默。

en: I'm at home from six o'clock in the evening to eight o'clock in the morning.
cn: 晚上六点到上午八点在家。

en: Sometimes, you need to be alone. Not to be lonely, but to enjoy some free time just being yourself.
cn: 有时候你需要一个人呆着。不是寂寞，而是享受只做自己的自由时光。

en: An idea not properly analyzed is not worth exploiting, just as a life without self-judgment is not worth living.
cn: 没有经过仔细审视的观念是不值得拥有的，正如没有经过仔细审视的生活不值得过一样。

en: The doctors did all they could to control Tom's disease but, sadly, to no avail.
cn: 医生们尽力控制汤姆的病情了但可惜无法奏效。

en: Tom said he thought he might be the only one who had to do that.
cn: 汤姆说他以为需要做那件事的就只有他一个。

en: As I've already mentioned before, after a rigorous investigation, we have found nothing wrong with our company's management.
cn: 正如我之前提到的，经过严格的调查后，我们发现公司的管理层没有任何问题。

en: The doctor told Mr Smith to give up smoking if he wanted to live long.
cn: 医生告诉史密斯先生他要长寿的话就得戒烟。

en: Is it true that our genetic heritage is almost the same as that of chimpanzees?
cn: 我们的遗传基因真的和黑猩猩几乎一样吗？

en: This is an East Asian concept -- it's a little tricky to explain in Spanish.
cn: 这是一个东方的概念，用西班牙语不太好解释。

en: Tom and I sat on a bench in the park and talked while we fed pigeons.
cn: 我和汤姆在公园的长椅上坐着，一边聊天一边喂着鸽子。

en: Tom didn't know how to translate the word "computer" because the people he was talking to had never seen one.
cn: 汤姆不知如何翻译“计算机”一词，因为同他谈话的人从未见过一台。

en: Not only did you not eat with me, you went to have dinner with another girl!
cn: 你不但不和我一起吃饭，反而去和另一个女生吃饭！

en: No matter whether it is cold or hot, when she goes out, she always brings a scarf.
cn: 不论天气冷还热，她出门总带着围巾。

en: We are going to move house, but I still don't know where we are moving to.
cn: 我们要搬家了，但是我还不知道要搬到哪里去。

en: In China, southern people eat rice as staple food; northern people eat wheaten food as staple food.
cn: 在中国，南方人以米饭为主食，北方人以面食为主食。

en: If I knew you were sick, I would have gone to the hospital to pay you a visit.
cn: 如果我知道你生病了，我会去医院看望你。

en: His upper body looks like it has the shape of an inverted triangle; standing there, he seems extremely handsome!
cn: 他上身长得呈倒三角形，站在那里看上去特帅！

en: Tomorrow the Chinese national team play against the Korean national team in their home arena.
cn: 明天中国国家队主场对阵韩国国家队。

en: The speaker didn't know his subject, nor did he speak well; in short, he was disappointing.
cn: 演讲者不熟悉他的主题，说得又不好，总之，他很糟糕。

en: When Mary was spoken to by a stranger, she was at a loss for words.
cn: 当一个陌生人来和玛丽说话时，她不知道该说什幺了。

en: Everything has two sides: the good side and the bad side. Unfortunately, we usually see only one of them.
cn: 事物皆有两面：好的一面和坏的一面。不幸的是，我们往往只能看见其中的一面。

en: I don't believe that some day a majority of the world's population will speak Esperanto.
cn: 我不太相信将来的一天世界上大多数人都会讲世界语。

en: He seems very interested in musical theatre and the like, and he also seems quite adept.
cn: 他好像对音乐剧什幺的很感兴趣，而且还非常内行。

en: The lack of gender in English is not due to the English having a more egalitarian culture.
cn: 英文中没有阴阳性并不是因为英国人的文化偏向平等。

en: In the world, there are 10 types of people: Those who understand binary and those that don't.
cn: 世界上有10种人：懂二进制的人和不懂二进制的人。

en: My colleague and I do the same job, but he was promised a promotion in a very short while.
cn: 我和我别的同事做同样的事情，但是得到了能在很短时间内得到晋升的承诺。

en: The natural landscape is characterised by its large amount of mountains, and it looks as truly beautiful as a painting.
cn: 这里的自然景观的特点是山非常多，而且像画一样特别美。

en: It will be able to edit the pictures you don't like, then print them out.
cn: 它可以将你不喜欢的照片修好，然后在印出来。

en: Her mom is from Spain and her dad is from Italy. That's why she can speak both Spanish and Italian.
cn: 她妈妈来自西班牙，她爸爸来自意大利，所以她会讲西班牙语和意大利语。

en: My birthday is June 12. Magdalena was born on the same day and year as me.
cn: 我的生日是六月十二日。玛格达莲娜和我同年同日生。

en: Just because a certain book does not interest readers does not mean that the fault lies in the book.
cn: 不是因为读者对某本书不感兴趣，这本书就肯定是有问题的了。

en: This science fiction story seems interesting. Will you lend it to me when you have finished reading it?
cn: 这个科幻故事似乎很有趣。你看完的时候能不能借给我？

en: I didn't know the city, and what's more, I couldn't speak a word of the language.
cn: 我不知道这个城市，而且我一点都不懂那里的语言。

en: If you cry because you miss the sun when it goes away, then you will also miss the stars.
cn: 如果，错过太阳的时候你在流泪，那幺你也将错过群星。

en: You need to hand in a few photos, fill in a form, and get a visa.
cn: 你要交几张照片，填好几张表格，办好签证。

en: Tom went swimming in the river, but when he got out, his clothes had been stolen.
cn: 汤姆去河里游泳，但当他出来时，他的衣服被偷了。

en: People who cannot find time for recreation are obliged sooner or later to find time for illness.
cn: 没工夫休息的人，早晚会有工夫生病的。

en: During that era, the fate of doctors was in the hands of people who did not understand medicine.
cn: 那个时代，医生的命运掌握在不懂医术的人的手里。

en: Tom always speaks in such a low voice that I can barely understand what he says.
cn: 汤姆总是说话声音太小，我几乎听不懂他在说什幺。

en: We must take into account the wishes of all the family in planning a trip.
cn: 筹划旅行的时候，我们必须考虑到全家人的意愿。

en: After seeing the film, we are going to the café to get something to eat.
cn: 看完电影，到咖啡馆吃点东西吧。

en: The meeting between the school and the business is scheduled to be held on the 26th of December.
cn: 学校与企业见面会于12月26日按期举行。

en: Han, Manchu, Mongol, Hui and Tibetan people (as well as other minority groups in China) are kins in one family.
cn: 汉满蒙回藏（以及中国的其他少数族裔们）一家亲。

en: The relationship between the mind and the heart is much like the relationship between a castle's library and its master.
cn: 心灵与心之间的关系，通常如同一个城堡的图书馆与城堡主人之间的关系一样。

en: I am a serious clerk, and at home, I am a good wife and mother.
cn: 我是一个认真的文员，在家里，我是一个好妻子兼好母亲。

en: The school's lovely cherry blossoms drew a lot of residents to come and admire it.
cn: 学校的樱花开的烂漫，吸引了大量市民前来观赏。

en: I have three dogs. One of them is male and the other two are female.
cn: 我有三只狗，其中一只是公的，另外两只是母的。

en: Unfortunately, you will return to China soon, so I will have nobody to accompany me.
cn: 可惜你很快又会回中国，没人陪我了呢。

en: Germans are not willing to produce nuclear energy, but are not against using that of their neighbouring countries.
cn: 德国人不愿意生产核电，但他们不反对使用邻国的。

en: In July of 2015, the highest temperature in the capital city of Iraq, Baghdad, was 51.1 degrees Celsius.
cn: 2015 年 7 月，伊拉克首都巴格达出现摄氏 51.1 度的高温。

en: If confidence, determination and courage are together in one place, there is nothing that cannot be done.
cn: 信心、毅力、勇气三者具备，则天下没有做不成的事。

en: Welcome. Now that many people have arrived, please take a seat and wait for a while.
cn: 欢迎光临，现在人很多，请坐下来等一等。

en: Because I left early this morning, I couldn't use my computer, so I used my phone to send messages.
cn: 因为今早要出门，不能用电脑，所以用手机发信息。

en: Deep down, everyone is rich and beautiful, but we don't know how to express it!
cn: 内心世界很丰富，不知该如何表达了！

en: It is better to teach someone how to fish than to give someone a fish.
cn: 授之以鱼，不如授之以渔。

en: It has four legs, it is made of wood and it lives in the kitchen.
cn: 它有四条腿，是木制的而且站在厨房里。

en: Despite the fact that he has only just started learning Chinese, he already knows lots of characters.
cn: 尽管他是一周前才开始学中文的，然而他已经认识很多字了。

en: I don't think that it is possible to generalise about a whole nation and say how all Japanese people are.
cn: 我觉得不可以泛化一个民族，说日本人怎幺样。

en: In "明", what is the character on the left? And the one on the right?
cn: “明”这个汉字左边是什么？右边是什么？

en: Mary has failed again, but the good thing is that she is still very young.
cn: 玛丽再次失败。但好的是她还很年轻。

en: Outside of working hours, you can get a hold of him through his private phone.
cn: 工作时间以外，可以打他的私人电话找到他。

en: Thank you for helping me. Please turn off the light, I want to go to sleep.
cn: 我谢谢你帮帮忙，给我把灯关了，我想睡觉了。

en: Due to the large amounts of snow over the last few days, school has been cancelled.
cn: 由于这几天下了很多雪，因此学校停课了。

en: When we started, we thought that we knew everything, but we later discovered that we did not.
cn: 开始的时候，我们以为我们什幺都知道，但后来发现，事实是我们什幺都不知道。

en: It is very difficult to work with people who are not willing to do so.
cn: 跟不情愿的人很难一起工作。

en: A lie is like a flower in full bloom. It may look pretty, but it wilts quickly.
cn: 谎言像一朵盛开的鲜花，外表美丽，生命短暂。

en: It doesn't matter how others see you. What is important is to be sure to affirm your own self.
cn: 别人怎样看自己不重要,重要的是要保证自己得到自己的认同。

en: I have two tickets to the baths, do you want to come with me today?
cn: 我有两张洗澡票在那儿，今天和我一起去洗澡吗？

en: Before you put the noodles in the pot, you have to break them up into small pieces.
cn: 面条下锅前要先掰成小块。

en: A person's happiness does not come from owning a lot, but from caring about little.
cn: 一个人的快乐，不是因为他拥有得多，而是因为他计较得少。

en: Therefore, for the glorious God, you must accept each other, and accept Jesus Christ in the same way.
cn: 所以，为了荣耀上帝，你们要彼此接纳，就像基督接纳你们一样。

en: Xiao Wang, can I use your bike? Forget I said that, you are riding it!
cn: 小王，我可以用一下你的自行车吗？那没说的，你骑走吧！

en: In spite of the fact that drinking alcohol damages their bodies, many people still like to drink it.
cn: 尽管喝酒对身体不好，很多人还是喜欢喝。

en: China is a sleeping tiger, but once it wakes up, it will shock the world.
cn: 中国是一只沉睡的狮子，一旦觉醒，将会震惊世界。

en: Mistakes and lying can be worked through, but I cannot stand a complete lack of humour.
cn: 错误和谎言我都可以忍受，但我不能原谅幽默感的彻底丧失。

en: The method used for tests in Australia is not meant to be difficult for the people sitting them.
cn: 澳洲的考试方式并不是为了刁难受测者。

en: I am already very tired, but I still have a lot of work I need to do.
cn: 我已经很困了，但是我还有很多事情要做。

en: It is difficult to keep up a conversation with someone who only says "yes" and "no".
cn: 和一个只说"是"与"否"的人维持一段对话是很难的。

en: Everyone is a moon, and has a dark side which he never shows to anybody.
cn: 每一个人像月亮一样，有一个不会给任何人看的黑面。

en: In the past, I was a middle school student. Now I am a college student.
cn: 过去,我是中学生,现在我是大学生.

en: I'm feeling better now, but I know that my father will still be very worried.
cn: 我现在感觉好多了，但我知道爸爸还是会很担心。

en: Every month when I receive my salary, I give 5000 Japanese Yen to my mother.
cn: 每月发工资的那天，我给我妈5000日元。

en: An elderly person in my family suddenly fell to the ground; he likely suffered a stroke.
cn: 我家里有个老年人突然倒在地上，大概是中风了。

en: There will always be things I will never learn, I don't have eternity before me!
cn: 总有一些东西我永远不能学会，我的生命不是永恒的！

en: She was scolded by her mother for forgetting to turn off the light when she left the house.
cn: 她因为离开家的时候忘记关灯而被妈妈说了。

en: Your stomach has been rumbling for quite a while now. Are you sure you're all right?
cn: 刚才你肚子一直在叫，没事吧？

en: When we are told not to come, we become all the more eager to go.
cn: 让我们别来，我们就更想来了。

en: I learned to drive a car and got a driver's license when I was eighteen.
cn: 我十八岁时，学了开车、考到了驾照。

en: Which translation of this book do you think is better, the French one or the English one?
cn: 你觉得这本书的哪个译本比较好？法语的还是英语的？

en: If it rains on that day, the game will be postponed until the next fine day.
cn: 如果那天下雨，比赛会顺延至下一个晴天。

en: Mary said she thought she might have to do that before she can go home.
cn: 玛丽说她以为必须先完成这件事才能回家。

en: I don't think that it's very likely that Tom will tell us the truth about what happened.
cn: 我不认为汤姆会把事情的真相告诉我们。

en: If he didn't order this investigation, she could have flown under the radar for years.
cn: 要是他没有下令做这个调查她本可以瞒天过海好多年。

en: All of your accusations are baseless. She is innocent, and we are going to prove that.
cn: 你所有的指控都是毫无根据的。她是无辜的，并且我们将证明这一点。

en: Since I was the one they saw, they might think I was the one who did that.
cn: 因为他们看到的人是我，所以他们可能会认为是我干的。

en: This afternoon, the World Health Organization confirmed three thousand new cases of coronavirus, among which a hundred people died.
cn: 今天下午，世界卫生组织证实了3000个新型冠状病毒病例，其中有100人死亡。

en: The authorities disclosed little useful information about the spread of COVID-19 at the beginning of the outbreak.
cn: 当局在疫情之初几乎没有透露关于新型冠状病毒的有用信息。

en: Tom says he isn't sure if he can do that, but he says he'll try.
cn: 汤姆说他不确定是否能做到，但是他说会尝试。

en: Jiang Feng's servant hired the "Twelve Zodiacs" to kill him. They ambushed him and his wife Yuenu.
cn: 江枫的仆人雇了十二生肖杀江枫，他们伏击了江枫和江枫的妻子月奴。

en: If someone in the class has a birthday, the teacher always draws a flag on the blackboard.
cn: 如果班上有人过生日, 老师总是会在黑板上画一面旗子。

en: He thought, If I don't study hard, how can I be worthy of my countrymen?
cn: 他想，如果不好好学习，怎幺对得起祖国的人民呢？

en: When I'm away from home, I miss it dearly, but when I am at home, I want to travel.
cn: 不在祖国的时候我很想家，但是在家的时候我又想旅游

en: The president predicted that once the coronavirus is gone, the stock markets “will pop back up like nobody has seen.”
cn: 总统预测，一旦冠状病毒消失，股票市场“会像从未有人见过般回弹。”

en: During the Depression in the 1930's, many wealthy people lost everything in the stock market crash.
cn: 在十九世纪三十年代的大萧条时期，许多富人在股市崩盘中失去了一切。

en: I don't mind lending you the money provided you pay it back within a month.
cn: 假如能一个月之内还上的话，我可以把钱借给你。

en: No matter how hard I try, I can't do it any better than she can.
cn: 无论我多幺努力尝试，我都无法做到比她更好。

en: Out of all the attributes of the gods, the one I find most pitiable is their inability to commit suicide.
