en: I didn't tell Mary why I didn't want her to go to Boston with me.
cn: 我没告诉玛丽为什么我不想让她和我一起去波士顿。

en: The statue of the Minute Man commemorates the valiant soldiers who fought in the Revolutionary War.
cn: 民兵雕像是为了纪念独立战争中英勇作战的士兵。

en: To give a definition of a word is more difficult than to give an illustration of its usage.
cn: 要为一个字下定义比为字的用法举例更困难。

en: The barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, especially used to study climate and to determine altitudes.
cn: 气压表是一种用来测量大气压力的仪器，主要用于研究气候和测量高度。

en: Only when the poor enter the halls of the rich, do the rich notice that the poor exist.
cn: 只有当穷人进入富人的大厅之时，富人才会注意到穷人的存在。

en: A man can no more become a woman than a monkey can develop into a man.
cn: 男人不能变成女人，就像猴子不能进化成人类一样。

en: Don't believe everything you say, don't say everything you know, don't do everything you want.
cn: 不要相信你所说的一切，不要说一切你知道的事情，不要做你想做的一切。

en: I am always freed of all of my worries and concerns in the depth of the night.
cn: 在深夜，我总是如释重负。

en: Karl Marx says, "The history of all hitherto existing societies is the history of class struggles."
cn: 卡尔·马克思说：“ 到目前为止的一切社会的历史都是阶级斗争的历史。”

en: He said he was angry, and that he wanted to go home to eat dinner.
cn: 他说他很生气，还有他要回家吃晚饭了。

en: I've written an article. Could you take a look and tell me if it's okay?
cn: 我写了一篇文章，麻烦您看一下它行不行。

en: I'm sorry darling, you are merely a single tree in a forest, I just can't drop everything for you.
cn: 不好意思美女，我不会为了你这一颗树，放弃一片森林。

en: A person who hates creates his own hell, but a person who loves has heaven within.
cn: 一个充满了恨的人为自己创造了地狱，而一个拥有爱的人心中存在着天堂。

en: I'm so dumb... I'm trying to explain things to you that I don't understand myself.
cn: 我太愚蠢了...我竟然试着给你解释我自己都不懂的东西。

en: God is the creator. Heaven and Earth and people and everything apart from God are created.
cn: 上帝就是造物主。天空，土地以及人类，一切都出自上帝之手，除了上帝自身以外。

en: I can't check to see if your email is correct or not because it's too short.
cn: 我没法确认你的邮件地址是否正确，因为它太短了。

en: It was I who found her. She'd lost consciousness, so I carried her to the infirmary.
cn: 是我发现她的。她当时已经失去了意识，所以我把她送到了疗养院。

en: There are three kinds of people in the world: those who can count, and those who can't.
cn: 世上有三种人：会数数的和不会数数的。

en: It's really difficult to survive in a big city like Tokyo without going into debt.
cn: 要在一个像东京一样的大都市里过活，不借钱是很困难的。

en: No matter how cold the weather is, I go to the park every day to run.
cn: 不管天气多幺冷，我每天都去公园跑步。

en: The staff in this shop are really friendly. It's no wonder they've got so much custom.
cn: 这家商店人员的态度特好，怪不得顾客也好多。

en: At that time, the two main schools of thought in psychology were behaviourism and psychoanalysis.
cn: 在那个年代，心理学的两个主要学派是行为主义学派与精神分析学派。

en: Ah, now I remember – I left it on the table where I filled in the application form.
cn: 哦，想起来了，忘记在填报名单的桌子上。

en: The ecological footprint of a country is closely related to its level of economic development.
cn: 生态印迹与一国的经济发展程度密切相关。

en: To prevent them from being pirated, some of his films were never shown at the cinema.
cn: 为了防止盗版，他有些电影从未在影院上映。

en: The façade of this building is bizarre. What the architect was thinking I don't know.
cn: 这座大楼的外观很奇怪，不知道设计师是怎么想的。

en: Owing to its landmass, the Antarctic has an air temperature lower than that of the Arctic.
cn: 南极因为有大陆，所以气温低于北极。

en: Mary, you shouldn't chop food without using a chopping board, no matter how short a time it is for.
cn: 玛丽，不管是多快的活儿，妳都不应该不用菜板切菜。

en: I have the power of invisibility, but it only works when I’m wearing a freshly washed shirt.
cn: 我有隐身之能，不过仅限于我穿一件刚洗过的上衣的时候。

en: My friends always say I'm too calm, but my family always says I'm too annoying.
cn: 我的朋友们总是说我太安静了，而我的家人总是说我太让人烦了。

en: You won't solve this kind of problem by talking about it; you have to take action.
cn: 这种问题不是随便说说就会被解决掉的，你得去行动才行。

en: When I hear the news, I get goose bumps. How could there be such a dangerous thing?
cn: 听到这条新闻我直起鸡皮疙瘩，怎么会有这样危险的事啊？

en: Did you hear that? That was Mary. She slams the door like that when she's angry.
cn: 你听见了吗？刚那是玛丽。她生气时就会那样摔门。

en: Tomorrow is the first time I will accompany the Chinese delegation, and I'm extremely nervous.
cn: 明天第一次陪中国代表团， 我紧张得不得了。

en: I see him eating and sleeping, sleeping and eating, playing games whenever, lazy in the utmost!
cn: 我看他，吃了又睡，睡了又吃，游戏打了又打，懒得不得了！

en: The food at this hot pot restaurant really tastes pretty good. Let's come here again next time.
cn: 这家火锅店的味道还挺不错的嘛，下次我们再来吃吧。

en: The food at this hot pot restaurant tastes really good. Let's come here again next time.
cn: 这家火锅店的味道真不错，下次我们再来吃吧。

en: His dress is that of a gentleman, but his speech and behavior are those of a clown.
cn: 他衣着像个绅士，言行举止却像个小丑。

en: When I tried to set the glass down in the sink my hand slipped and it shattered to pieces.
cn: 当我试着把玻璃杯放进水槽时，我的手打了滑，玻璃杯打碎了。

en: Sturgeons can sometimes live for over 50 years, growing so large that few predators hunt them.
cn: 鲟鱼有时长得比一些它的捕食者还大，寿命甚至能超过50年。

en: One hundred and fifty thousand couples are expected to get married in Shanghai in 2006.
cn: 预计2006年15万对夫妇将会在上海结婚。

en: He has been devoted to the study of atomic energy ever since he graduated from the university.
cn: 从他大学毕业后，他就一直致力于原子能的研究。

en: Even if the sun were to rise in the west, I would not change my mind.
cn: 即使太阳从西边出来，我也不会改变主意。

en: English is still a foreign language to me, even though I speak it every day.
cn: 尽管我每天都说英文，但它对我来说还是外语。

en: Mangroves sequester more carbon than any other trees on Earth because they have quite a large underground root structure.
cn: 红树林吸取二氧化碳比地球上其他树木都要多，因为它们具有很大的地下根部结构。

en: This author doesn't understand at all why a man and a woman who can't become lovers would become friends.
cn: 这个作者完全不懂为什幺一对不能够成为恋人的男女会成为朋友。

en: My mom tried to help me at first, but then she gave up in no time.
cn: 一开始我妈试着帮我，但她很快就放弃了。

en: We're heading back. We'll make sure to take care of what you asked us to do.
cn: 我们要回去啦，你托我们的事情一定留心着。

en: I thought I traveled to Japan, but the locals kept telling me I was in Ohio.
cn: 我以为自己到了日本，但是当地人都说我在俄亥俄。

en: For you to come out and say that kind of thing now would just be pouring oil on the fire.
cn: 你现在说这种话，只会火上加油。

en: No matter what grand and lofty reason you have, it's not right to do this.
cn: 不管你有什幺冠冕堂皇的理由，这样做是不对的。

en: In front of the Buddhist Hall, a sign says: "Beware of all the life under your steps."
cn: 佛堂前面的一个牌子上写着：“注意脚下众生。”

en: They said humanity needs to rebuild the Tower of Babel, I have no comment on this.
cn: 他们说人类要重建巴别塔，我对此不予评价。

en: The red circle on the calendar marking the deadline causes me to fall into anxiety.
cn: 日历上画着红圈的截稿日期使我陷入了焦虑。

en: This teacher always drags his class time, taking up the students' rest time, later he got reported, it felt amazing.
cn: 这个老师总是拖堂，占用同学们课间休息的时间，后来他被举报了，真过瘾啊。

en: No man has the imagination required to grasp female reason, which is why it is called unreasonable.
cn: 没有男人有能把控住女性理性的想象力，这就是为什幺它被说无理。

en: Our beloved father would read us some prose every week to better our understanding of the world's beauty.
cn: 我们亲爱的父亲每周都会给我们阅读散文，好让我们认识到世界的美好之处。

en: There's a photo of the bride and groom together on the invitation sent to friends.
cn: 发给好朋友的请帖上有新郎新娘合影的照片。

en: People could not see any hopes of obtaining happiness in this life, thus they instinctively sought comfort in the afterlife.
cn: 人们在此世中看不到任何获得幸福的希望，便很本能地想在彼世中寻求慰藉。

en: My wife and I sat on the couch to watch one of our favorite shows.
cn: 我和老婆坐在沙发上看我俩特别喜欢看的一个节目。

en: When I speak up at the wrong moment, I often get my friends and myself into difficult situations.
cn: 当我在错误的时候开口时，我总是让我和我的朋友陷入困境。

en: I just saw a beautiful peacock displaying its feathers while on a walk in the forest.
cn: 我刚才在树林里散步时看见了一只漂亮的孔雀在开屏。

en: Six hundred dollars a month, with a day rest every week. That works for you?
cn: 每月六百元，每周一天休息，行吗？

en: It was all thanks to his recommendation that I was able to become a teacher at a college in Tokyo.
cn: 多亏了他的推荐，我得以在东京的一所大学里担任老师。

en: She and her fiancée are together for so long, they are ready to get married.
cn: 她和未婚夫在一起这幺久，都要结婚了。

en: How dare you say that that temple is a ruined temple...aren't you afraid of being struck by lightning?
cn: 你敢说那庙是个破庙...你不怕被雷劈了吗？

en: I've got nothing to do, so I'm writing some sentences for other people to learn.
cn: 我没事写点句子让他人学习。

en: But meanwhile it flees: time flees irretrievably, while we wander around, prisoners of our love of detail.
cn: 但与此同时，它却在消逝：时间无可挽回地流逝， 而我们却四处游荡，成为我们对细节的热爱的囚徒。

en: You shouldn't deny the validity of everything she did just because of a single mistake.
cn: 你不能因为她所犯下的一个错误就否定她所做的一切。

en: The speed at which native speakers of other languages are adding sentences doesn't even compare to theirs.
cn: 其它母语的使用者添加句子的速度也比不过他们的。

en: I often go to my mother-in-law and father-in-law's house on Sundays to help them do physical work.
cn: 我星期天常常到丈人丈母家去帮他们干点力气活。

en: The third batch of vaccines provided by China to Colombia has arrived in Bogota, the capital of Colombia.
cn: 中国向哥伦比亚提供的第三批疫苗运抵哥伦比亚首都波哥大。

en: They hurried off to watch a football game, leaving their things all over the house.
cn: 他们匆匆忙忙去看足球赛，屋里头东西都丢在那儿。

en: Anyway, at the age of 22 one knows everything, so what's the use of reading?
cn: 反正到了二十二岁什幺都知道了，看书还有什幺用呢。

en: From now on, you should exercise regularly. I bought some health supplements for you to try.
cn: 这以后要经常锻炼，我买了点补药给你吃吃看。

en: Because the stadium is not far from my house, I often go to football games.
cn: 因为体育场离我家不远，我往往去看足球赛。

en: There is a large temperature difference between day and night during this period of time.
cn: 这段时间昼夜温差很大。

en: No need to argue, there is nothing that only has bad effects and no benefits.
cn: 不必争,没有事情是只有坏处而没有好处的.

en: I love my family very much, they are the most important people in my life.
cn: 我非常爱我的家人，他们是我生活中最重要的人。

en: I know that Tom knows that Mary knows that she doesn't have to do that.
cn: 我知道汤姆知道玛丽知道她自己不需要这么做

en: At first I thought the development board was up the spout, but it was just a loose connection.
cn: 本来以为是开发板给我弄坏了，原来是电源线接触不良。

en: All humans are equal and independent. No one can damage another's life, health, freedom, and property.
cn: 一切人都是平等和独立的，没有人有权损害另一个人的生命、健康、自由和财产。

en: By saying the wrong thing at the wrong time, I kept getting myself and my friends into awkward situations.
cn: 我在不恰当的时机说错了话, 不断的使我自己和我的朋友陷于尴尬的处境。

en: It won't be a big deal if you put off buying it for a day!
cn: 忍着一天不买又不会怎样！

en: I'll be going to Australia next week, but I'm not really looking forward to it.
cn: 下星期我要去澳大利亚，但是我不太想去。

en: Behind his house is a stream so clear that you can see the bottom of it.
cn: 他家后面有小溪，清可见底。

en: I really wish I could go to bed early every day and get up early!
cn: 我非常希望每天都能早睡早起！

en: I knew it was out of our price range, but I wanted to buy it anyway.
cn: 我知道超出我们的预算了，但是我就想买下来。

en: The Nobel Prize is awarded annually on December 10, the day of Alfred Nobel's death.
cn: 诺贝尔奖在每年的十二月十日颁发，是Alfred Nobel去世的那天。

en: The girl in the picture has a flower wreath on her head, and not a golden crown.
cn: 画中的女孩头上戴着的是花冠，不是金皇冠。

en: Even though a parameter's value can change, it is treated as a constant, not as a variable.
cn: 尽管参数的值可变，但我们仍把它视为常量，而非变量。

en: As soon as I came I washed the dishes, so how come you ask me to leave?!
cn: 我一来就在洗碗，你凭什幺叫我走！

en: I finished the homework, and want to go to bed, but now it's time to go to school again...
cn: 我作业做完了，想睡觉了，可是又到得去上学的时候了。

en: The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only a page.
cn: 世界是本书，不旅游的人只看了一页。

en: It was proven that fleas living on dogs jump higher than fleas living on cats.
cn: 寄生在狗身上的跳蚤已被证明跳得比寄生在猫身上的高。

en: I had to wait for Tom to pay me the money he owed me before I could pay you back.
cn: 我得先等汤姆把他欠我的钱给还了，才能把欠你的还给你。

en: Tom said that he thought he'd be able to help Mary weed the garden today.
cn: 汤姆说他以为他今天能够帮玛丽的花园除草

en: Take this as friendly advice: I think you should do sport more often to keep yourself fit.
cn: 把它当成友好的建议，但我认为你应该多运动来保持你自己的体型和健康。

en: He got where he wanted to be in life by just using his raw mental strength and willpower.
cn: 他仅凭借精神力量和意志力就达到了他所想要的生活。

en: Tom told Mary that he was going to kill himself, but he didn't have the courage to do it.
cn: 汤姆告诉玛丽他想要自杀，但他没有那幺做的勇气。

en: I am really extremely angry, so I plan to smash things to vent my anger.
cn: 我实在气得不得了，所以打算砸东西发泄。

en: If you want to make money, study English; but if you want to have friends, learn Esperanto.
cn: 想赚钱的话就学英语，但想交朋友的话就该学世界语。

en: I had neither the time to go shopping, nor to say goodbye to my mother.
cn: 我既没时间购物，又没时间跟我妈妈说再见。

en: In 1955, the cancer returned and she died in 1956 at the age of 42.
cn: 1955年她的癌症复发，她1956年去世，享年42岁。

en: A sports bra should only be worn for working out, and not in any non-sports situations.
cn: 运动内衣最好只在运动时穿着，在其他非运动场合不穿。

en: When you send a telegram, brevity is essential because you will be charged for every word.
cn: 当我们发电报的时候，简明扼要是关键，因为是以字计费的。

en: The wicked witch cast a spell on the man and turned him into a bug.
cn: 恶毒的巫婆在男人身上施了咒语，把他变成了一只虫子。

en: Everything reactionary is the same; if you do not hit it, it will not fall.
cn: 凡是反动的东西，你不打，它就不倒。

en: The Latin language is not entirely unknown to me, but I altogether lack the ability to speak it.
cn: 拉丁语对我来说不是完全陌生的，但我不懂说这门语言。

en: Every night, when all was quiet, he would steal into his neighbour's garden to scrump an apple.
cn: 每天晚上，当周围安静下来，他就会偷溜进邻居的花园里偷走一颗苹果。

en: A revolution is an insurrection, an act of violence by which one class overthrows another.
cn: 革命就是一场暴动，一场由一个阶级推翻另一个阶级的暴力行动。

en: He that buys what he does not want, must often sell what he does want.
cn: 买了不想要的东西，往往得要卖掉想要的东西。

en: Our employees are working around the clock to fix the damage caused by the ice storm.
cn: 我们的员工正在争分夺秒地修理冰暴带来的损坏。

en: I told Tom it would be dangerous to do that, but he still wanted to do it.
cn: 我和汤姆说过那样做很危险，但他还是想那样做。

en: It is incomprehensible to us that a country with that level of technology would even think of making an automobile.
cn: 只有那样技术的国家，还想要做汽车，我们十分无法理解。

en: You know the phrase, we reap what we sow. I have sown the wind and this is my storm.
cn: 你也知道那句话，「善有善报，恶有恶报」。我搧的风，现在火就来了。

en: I think if someone acts like a child they should be treated like a child.
cn: 我认为，孩子气的人就应该当成孩子对待。

en: Not every addict is traumatized, but there would be a lot fewer addicts if a lot fewer people were traumatized.
cn: 不是每个瘾君子都有创伤；不过有创伤的人变少，瘾君子也会变少。

en: To be honest, as this world goes, is to be one man picked out of ten thousand.
cn: 老实说，世界在运转，有用的人万里挑一。

en: The ambitions of some Americans are limited by failing schools and hidden prejudice and the circumstances of their birth.
cn: 一些美国人的抱负因学校教育不完美、隐性的偏见和出生环境而受到限制。

en: The French government has launched an online game that challenges taxpayers to balance the national budget.
cn: 法国政府发布了一款线上游戏，让纳税人挑战平衡国家预算。

en: The trouble is not with impure politics, but that the whole game of politics is rotten.
cn: 问题不是政治不纯洁，而是整个政治博弈已经腐朽。

en: In WHAT THE CAR?, you play as a car with legs, racing through absurdly creative levels.
cn: 在《WHAT THE CAR?》中，您将操纵长着腿的汽车，在离谱又富有创意的关卡中赛跑。

en: Have you tried flipping burgers as a car in "WHAT THE CAR?"? It's hilariously bizarre.
cn: 你用过《WHAT THE CAR?》中的翻滚汉堡车吗？真是太荒诞可笑了！

en: Exploring hidden treasures behind waterfalls is one of my favorite parts of WHAT THE CAR?.
cn: 《WHAT THE CAR?》中我最喜欢的部分是探索瀑布之后的隐藏宝藏。

en: In WHAT THE CAR?, you can climb buildings and deliver packages—definitely not your typical racing game.
cn: 在《WHAT THE CAR?》中，您可以攀爬建筑物，还能运送包裹；绝对和你平时玩的赛车游戏不一样。

en: The space probe Lucy is expected to arrive in 2025 to the proximity of the asteroid Donaldjohanson.
cn: 太空探测器露西预计将于 2025 年抵达小行星唐纳德约翰逊附近。

en: A number of imaging techniques are employed in radiology, such as X-ray, MRI, and ultrasound.
cn: 放射学中采用了数种影像技术，比如 X 光、MRI 和超音波。

en: Mary had an ultrasound to find out the sex of her and Tom's unborn baby.
cn: 玛莉为了知道她和汤姆未出生的孩子的性别，做了超音波检查。

en: How do I feel about what I'm doing to get what I want out of life?
cn: 我对于自己为实现人生目标所做的事有何感受？

en: All social interactions, naturally, will involve some degree of insincerity, which I believe is necessary.
cn: 所有的社交，自然而然地，都会掺入一些虚伪的成分，我想这是有其必要的。

en: I'd like to know if I can write "One plus one equals three." on Tatoeba.
cn: 请问我在Tatoeba上能不能写「一加一等于三。」？

en: Build your own championship team in a new football management simulation game, launching in early November.
cn: 全新足球经理模拟游戏将于 11 月初推出，邀你打造属于自己的冠军球队。

en: Following a wave of other recent sports simulations, this release offers ball game fans a more authentic management experience.
cn: 在多款体育类模拟游戏陆续登场后，这款作品为热爱球类运动的玩家带来更真实的管理体验。

en: Every transfer window is a test of judgment and patience, and every match brings its own surprises and tension.
cn: 每一次转会谈判都是对眼光与耐性的考验，每一个比赛日都充满未知的挑战与压力。

en: We're delighted to bring this game back for the start of a new era for the series.
cn: 我们很高兴能再次推出这款游戏，并为系列作品开启全新的阶段。

en: Known for their colorful worlds and open-ended play, these games are scheduled to be available starting November 6.
cn: 这些游戏以缤纷的世界观与开放互动的玩法著称，预定于 11 月 6 日推出。

en: The subscription service is available for a fixed monthly fee with a one-month free trial.
cn: 此订阅服务的月费为固定金额，并提供免费试用一个月。

en: Customers who purchase a new device can enjoy additional trial period as a promotional offer.
cn: 购买新装置的用户可享有额外试用优惠。

en: Subscribers can play across phones, tablets, and computers, with certain games supporting multiplayer access and cloud sync.
cn: 订阅后可跨越手机、平板与电脑等装置游玩，部分游戏支援多人共享与云端同步功能。

en: Confidence and courage are not exclusively masculine traits—they are values that everyone can aspire to.
cn: 自信与勇气不仅是男性特质，也可以是所有人都能追求的价值。

en: To claim sex is binary requires ignoring intersex people, which is unscientific and purely ideological.
cn: 若要声称性别是二元的，就需要忽视阴阳人，这是不科学的，且纯粹属于意识形态问题。

en: In its more extreme variants, cis ideology can include denial of the empirical reality of intersex and transgender people.
cn: 在更极端的变体中，顺性别意识形态可能包括否认阴阳人和跨性别者的现实经历。

en: Some foreign words and names are not declined in Russian, usually depending on the ending and gender.
cn: 有些外来语和人名在俄语中没有变格，通常取决于词尾和性别。

en: A special feature of verbs in the Russian language is the presence of the category of aspect.
cn: 俄语动词的一个特征是存在体的范畴。

en: Russia started its illegal and unjustifiable war of aggression against Ukraine, and Russia can end it.
cn: 俄罗斯对乌克兰发动了非法、不公义的侵略战争，而俄罗斯应该终止这一切。

en: You didn't even show your nose the whole time I was cooking, and now you're here?
cn: 我煮饭的时候你都没露面过，现在你来了？

en: Julia Davis, a Russian media commentator, describes Victory Mania as “an unhealthy obsession with military might and past victories.”
cn: 俄罗斯媒体评论员朱莉娅戴维斯将胜利狂热描述为「对军事实力和旧有胜利的不健康的痴迷」。

en: Tom is filling his sentence counter on Tatoeba by adding translations from an English-Russian phrasebook.
cn: 汤姆在 Tatoeba 上添加英俄短语手册中的翻译，来增加他的句子数。

en: A book I happened to come across at a secondhand bookstore has now become my favorite.
cn: 我在二手书店看到一本书，现在它成为了我最爱的书。

en: John, who is the youngest in a family of seven, is the apple of his parents' eyes.
cn: 约翰是七口之家中最年幼的，是父母的心头肉。

en: A-che, did you see my phone? I think I left it on your desk just now.
cn: 阿哲你有没有看到我手机？我刚刚好像放在你桌上。

en: Shu-hwa said she wanted to work abroad next year, but her family talked her out of it.
cn: 淑华说她明年想出国打工，结果被家人劝退。

en: Chia-ling said her grandma knows how to use LINE now. She sends stickers every day.
cn: 佳玲说她阿嬷会用 LINE 了，还每天传贴图。

en: No matter how hard I try, I will never be able to catch up with him.
cn: 我无论怎么努力，都永远无法追上他。

en: Goethe claimed, "one who cannot speak foreign languages does not know one's own language either".
cn: 歌德曾说过：「不会说外语的人，也不懂自己的母语。」

en: If you connect your phone to your PC via USB, you can even transfer files and photos.
cn: 您如果透过 USB 将手机连接到电脑，则甚至可以传输档案和照片。

en: Do you need as many licenses as you have operating systems installed in a multi-boot PC?
cn: 在多重引导电脑上安装多少作业系统，就需要多少授权吗？

en: I wonder if it would be possible for you to introduce me to Mr. Harrison of PC Interactive Co. Ltd.
cn: 我想知道您能否把我介绍给 PC Interactive 有限公司的哈里森先生。

en: You can upgrade your computer with more random access memory to make the PC faster.
cn: 您可以使用更多任何存取记忆体来升级您的电脑，以提高 PC 的运行速度。

en: In the nineties, every computer started coming with a sound card, which really kicked off PC gaming.
cn: 在九十年代，每台电脑都开始配备音效卡，真正开启了 PC 游戏的时代。

en: Please stay on the line while your call is transferred to a customer service representative.
cn: 您的电话正在转接给客服代表，请不要挂断。

en: Many people get a job in customer services before they are qualified for other positions.
cn: 许多人在获得其他职位的资格之前就从事客服工作。

en: I had to wait 20 minutes on the phone before reaching the customer service rep.
cn: 我不得不在电话里等了 20 分钟才联系到客服代表。

en: Algeria needs to train its public sector employees on new technologies, communication skills, and customer service.
cn: 阿尔及利亚需要对其公共部门员工进行新技术、沟通技巧和客服方面的培训。

en: I lost my receipt and had to call customer service at both IKEA and the bank.
cn: 我遗失了收据，不得不给 IKEA 和银行的客服部门打电话。

en: Carlos's work as a customer service representative requires him to be friendly and helpful to customers.
cn: 卡洛斯的客服代表工作要求他对客户友好且乐于帮助客户。

en: Everyone who has had to deal with AI customer service knows how inferior it is to actual humans.
cn: 每个曾经与 AI 客服打交道的人都知道，AI 与真人相比有多么逊色。

en: Our on-line Customer Service Desk and trained support agents enable problems to be quickly identified and addressed.
cn: 我们的线上客服台和训练有素的支援代理能够快速识别和解决问题。

en: Then come with me for a moment. Let's check the warehouse. We might just find it there.
cn: 那您随我来一趟，咱们去仓库里找一找，说不定那里会有。

en: The service plan you choose will affect your user experience. Please be sure to compare the details carefully.
cn: 您选择的服务方案将影响您的使用体验，请务必仔细比较细节。

en: Now is the critical moment. Please stop being so stubborn and inflexible, completely unable to adapt flexibility.
cn: 现在正是关键的时候了，请不要还那么死脑筋，丝毫不知权变。

en: When foreign friends see century eggs for the first time, they all think they are spoiled eggs.
cn: 外国朋友第一次看到皮蛋，都以为是坏掉的蛋。

en: This job still has to be done by me. No one else can handle it.
cn: 这活儿还得俺来弄，别人可不行。

en: If you want to hear a scary story, I'll tell you about a dream I had a few weeks ago.
cn: 如果你想听恐怖故事，那我就把几个星期前作的梦告诉你吧。

en: The emergence of a third gender has added legal and administrative complications, creating unnecessary burdens.
cn: 第三性别的出现增加了法律和行政上的麻烦，徒增无谓的负担。

en: We raced against our deskmate to see who could memorize the text faster, and I lost.
cn: 我们和同桌比赛看谁背书快，结果我输了。

en: We all know that blue-eyed red-heads are sensitive to sunshine, burning more readily than dark-skinned people.
cn: 我们都知道，蓝眼睛红头发的人对阳光敏感，比深色皮肤的人更容易晒伤。

en: A gleam of real pride quickened most ingenuously in the Older Man's pale blue eyes.
cn: 老人淡蓝色的眼睛闪过一丝真诚的骄傲。

en: Organic kale is hand picked, washed and packed on site at Sprouting Farms, West Virginia, for retail and wholesale.
cn: 有机羽衣甘蓝在西维吉尼亚州的 Sprouting Farms 现场手工采摘、清洗和包装，提供零售和批发。

en: Forks go to the left side of the plate, and knives go to the right.
cn: 叉子放在盘子的左边，刀子放在右边。

en: As tectonic plates shifted, uniquely adapted species of dinosaur emerged on each continent through vicariance.
cn: 随着板块的移动，各大洲因地理隔离而出现了适应不同环境的独特恐龙物种。

en: I bought fruit on the way home too. What would you like to eat? There's bananas, peaches, apples.
cn: 我在回家的路上也买了水果。你想吃什么？有香蕉、桃子、苹果。

en: Purple clover is a type of plant that bees use as a source of food.
cn: 紫三叶草是一种被蜜蜂用来当作食物来源的植物。

en: Thoreau coveted the plant's strong purple stalk for a cane, and the robins eat its dark crimson-juiced berries.
cn: 梭罗垂涎于这种植物强壮的紫色茎秆，将其制成藤条，而知更鸟则以深红色汁液的浆果为食。

en: He cut it with the knife that he received as a present from his brother.
cn: 他用哥哥送给他的刀子切开了。

en: When we reached the fork, we hesitated between continuing towards the town or continuing towards the mountains.
cn: 我们到达岔路口时，犹豫是继续往城镇走去，还是继续往山上走去。

en: The most effective way to kill time, of course, is chatting, bragging, and having wild conversations.
cn: 消磨时间的最有效办法当然还是聊天吹牛侃大山。

en: Our solar system has eight major planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.
cn: 我们的太阳系有八大行星：水星、金星、地球、火星、木星、土星、天王星和海王星。

en: The promotion of a piece to a king is indicated by setting on it another piece of the same color.
cn: 在一颗棋子上放置另一颗相同颜色的棋子，可以表示这颗棋子晋升为王。

en: I'd try looking for it next to the tinned fruit section at the back of the shop.
cn: 我会尝试在商店后面的水果罐头区旁边寻找它。

en: Since it's my day off today, I'm going to treat myself to a family-sized tub of walnut ice cream.
cn: 今天是我的休息日，我要买一整桶家庭装的核桃冰淇淋犒劳自己。

en: The large old walnut tree on the hill was struck by lightning and caught fire.
cn: 山上的那棵高大的老核桃树被雷击中并起火了。

en: There's a shortage of the soda I drink. None of the stores I've gone to have any.
cn: 我喝的汽水缺货了，我去的几家店都没货了。

en: Mike waited outside the chippy for Dani while she ordered a large portion of chips.
cn: 丹妮点了一大份薯条，麦克在炸鱼薯条店外等她。

en: Anna's striking almond-shaped eyes, inherited from her Asian lineage, exude a captivating depth and a hint of mystery.
cn: 安娜引人注目的杏仁状眼睛继承了她的亚洲血统，散发着迷人的深度和一丝神秘感。

en: The almond tree says to the snow: "Either you make it all white, or you make us white".
cn: 杏树对雪说：「要幺你把一切都变成白色，要幺你把我们也变成白色。」

en: In family photos, Ciham appears carefree. She poses casually for the camera, her hair pulled into a braided ponytail.
cn: 在家庭照片中，西哈姆看起来无忧无虑。她对着镜头摆出一副随兴的姿势，头发绑成马尾。

en: Hey Mary, you always wear a ponytail. Why not try pigtails every now and then?
cn: 嘿，玛丽，妳总是绑马尾。为什么不偶尔试试双马尾呢？

en: I saw an old and hollow pecan tree that had some bees flying around it.
cn: 我看到一棵老旧的空心山核桃树，周围有一些蜜蜂在飞。

en: I suspect Koreans must have trained their wrist strength to use those iron chopsticks so well.
cn: 我怀疑韩国人是练过腕力才用得好那种铁筷。

en: Housing prices in Hsinchu City have risen sharply due to the concentration of the tech industry.
cn: 新竹市区的房价因为科技产业聚集而水涨船高。

en: I went to the Hsinchu Science Park during summer vacation and saw many high-tech companies.
cn: 我暑假去了新竹科技园区，见识了许多高科技公司。

en: The sea is deep blue, and from afar it looks like a vast sheet of silk spread out.
cn: 海水蓝蓝的，远远看去像一大片丝绸铺开。

en: The first time he came to Taipei, he specifically wanted to go shopping in Ximending.
cn: 他第一次来台北，就指名要去西门町逛街。

en: This type of exercise can be practiced alone and does not require a coach's guidance.
cn: 这类运动可以单人练习，不需教练指导。

en: Stretching is an important part of exercise that should not be ignored before and after workouts.
cn: 拉伸是运动前后不可忽略的重要环节。

en: The London to Amsterdam flight was partially powered with a mixture of coconut and babassu nut oil.
cn: 伦敦飞往阿姆斯特丹的航班部分动力来自椰子油和巴巴苏坚果油的混合物。

en: In the USA, there have never been as many drug addicts as there are today.
cn: 在美国，吸毒成瘾者的数量从未像今天这样多。

en: On busy days like this, I'm glad to have a few dishes I can whip up quickly.
cn: 像今天这样忙碌的日子，我很庆幸自己能简单做几道菜。

en: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.
cn: 现在我们什么也做不了，救不了汤姆。我们唯一能做的就是祈祷。

en: Just as I was about to get into the bathtub, Tom dropped by for a visit.
cn: 正当我准备进浴缸的时候，汤姆来拜访我。

en: I'm grateful to him for catching my hat that I lost on the windy street.
cn: 我的帽子被风吹到大街上，我很感谢他帮我接住了。

en: If you'd sent the letter by special delivery on Friday, it would've arrived by now.
cn: 如果你周五用特快专递寄出这封信，现在应该已经到了。

en: Two women wielding giant spatulas continuously stir a brimming wok of shredded beef simmering in curry sauce.
cn: 两名女子挥舞着巨大的锅铲，不停地翻炒着盛满咖哩酱汁的牛肉丝。

en: Tom has come to know that a large, thin spatula works best for turning over pancakes or latkes.
cn: 汤姆逐渐了解到，用又大又薄的铲子翻煎饼或马铃薯饼效果最好。

en: Tom and Mary's little boy loves sitting on the kitchen floor banging pots and pans.
cn: 汤姆和玛莉的小儿子喜欢坐在厨房地板上敲打锅碗瓢盆。

en: Clean up spills inside the oven as soon as they happen to avoid stubborn stains.
cn: 烤箱内如有液体洒出，应立即清理，以免留下顽固污渍。

en: But with the threat of a coronavirus epidemic, things might not look so sunny for Florida tourism.
cn: 但随着新冠病毒疫情的威胁，佛罗里达州的旅游业前景可能并不乐观。

en: In Tbilisi, you can find the only mosque in the world where shia and sunni Muslims pray together.
cn: 在第比利斯，你可以看到世界上唯一一座什叶派和逊尼派穆斯林一起祈祷的清真寺。

en: The economist and statistician based in Ivory Coast says commercial trade in the region is primarily conducted with France.
cn: 这位常驻科特迪瓦的经济学家兼统计学家表示，该地区的商业贸易主要与法国进行。

en: The most commonly counterfeited medicines in poor countries are used to treat life-threatening conditions such as malaria, tuberculosis and HIV/AIDS.
cn: 在贫穷国家，最常见的仿冒药品是用来治疗疟疾、结核病和爱滋病等危及生命的疾病的药品。

en: Abraham removed from thence to the south country, and dwelt between Cades and Sur, and sojourned in Gerara.
cn: 亚伯拉罕从那里搬到南方，住在凯兹和苏尔之间，并在格拉拉停留了一段时间。

en: All oil-rich countries should be invaded and annihilated by US forces to protect their civilian populations and teach them democracy.
cn: 所有石油资源丰富的国家都应该被美国军队入侵并摧毁，以保护那里的平民并向他们传授民主。

en: Except for the bad weather and the frequent earthquakes, this is almost a perfect place to live.
cn: 这里除了恶劣的天气和频繁的地震之外，几乎就是一个完美的居住地。

en: On the country path, a gentle breeze blows, and the scent of night-blooming jasmine reminds one of childhood nights.
cn: 乡间小路上，微风拂过，夜来香的香味让人想起童年的夜晚。

en: It's best to keep a household medical manual by your pillow and read it from time to time.
cn: 最好备一本家用医卫手册在枕头边，常常翻翻看看。

en: My home is on the eighteenth floor, and both the master bedroom and the living room face south.
cn: 我家在十八层，主卧和客厅都面朝南方。

en: I didn't like the shirt that Tom gave me for my birthday, so I gave it to John.
cn: 我不喜欢生日那天汤姆送我的那件衬衫，所以我把它给了约翰。

en: For his first date, he chose an Italian restaurant and ordered seafood pasta, hoping to leave a romantic impression.
cn: 他第一次约会就选了义大利餐厅，点了海鲜义大利面，希望留下浪漫印象。

en: He did everything to be able to survive, hence he never wants to talk about it.
cn: 他为了活下去竭尽全力，所以他从来不想谈起这件事。

en: Rainy day, a day for keeping guests. Will you keep me or not? Yes, I will.
cn: 下雨天，留客天，留我不？留。

en: On a rainy day, we keep guests. Does Heaven want to keep me or not? Yes, it does.
cn: 下雨天留客，天留我不？留。

en: On a rainy day, we keep guests. Heaven wants to keep me? No, it doesn’t.
cn: 下雨天留客，天留我？不留。

en: When you walk around your house, what kind of scenery and buildings can you see?
cn: 当你在房子周围走动时，你能看到什么样的风景和建筑物？

en: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Armenia.
cn: 七月十七日，方舟停在亚美尼亚的山上。

en: This majestic mountain range in the heart of south Asia is crowned with snowcapped peaks and draped with vast glaciers.
cn: 这座位于南亚中心的雄伟山脉，山峰白雪皑皑，覆盖着广阔的冰川。

en: Most of the traffic coming into this seaside town is heading for the beachside holiday camp.
cn: 进入这座海滨小镇的车辆大多是前往海边度假营地的。

en: Hey, give me your digits. I will tell you about the seaside and the stars.
cn: 嘿，把你的电话号码给我。我会跟你讲讲海边和星星的故事。

en: Down in the valley a mist like a white feather rose gently into a white cloud, and obscured everything.
cn: 山谷中，薄雾如白色羽毛般缓缓升腾，化作一团白云，遮蔽了一切。

en: In his lectures, Professor Hunter prefers to study the blackboard rather than look at his students.
cn: 亨特教授在讲课时更喜欢盯着黑板看，而不是看学生。

en: Anne, go and stand on the platform in front of the blackboard for the rest of the afternoon.
cn: 安妮，妳下午剩下的时间就站在黑板前的平台上。

en: As Ziri ran out of the classroom, he bumped into someone and fell to the floor.
cn: 齐里跑出教室时撞到了人，摔倒在地。

en: If I had to be your husband, I'd rather hang myself on the first tree.
cn: 如果非要我当你的丈夫，我宁愿上吊死在第一棵树上。

en: The wood of trees in the pine family is much prized for construction and furniture making.
cn: 松科树木的木材因其优良的品质，在建筑和家具制造领域备受推崇。

en: The beautiful red leaves of the maple become detached from the branches and are dancing in the wind.
cn: 枫树美丽的红叶从枝头飘落，在风中翩翩起舞。

en: The arboretum includes more than 450 azaleas for landscaping, but also trees like maples, American elms, and hemlocks.
cn: 植物园内种植了 450 多株杜鹃花，还有枫树、美国榆树和铁杉等树木，用于景观美化。

en: She was closely related to the mighty Queen Zurline, and her home was beneath the shade of a widespreading oak.
cn: 她与强大的祖琳女王有着密切的血缘关系，她的家在一棵枝繁叶茂的橡树荫下。

en: The attic was a long, low-ceilinged room, dark and fragrant with the odor of the cedar.
cn: 阁楼是一个狭长的低矮房间，光线昏暗，弥漫着雪松的香气。

en: If the cedars have caught fire, what will the hyssops that grow out of the wall say?
cn: 如果雪松着火了，从墙里长出来的牛膝草会说什么呢？

en: The singer has a good opera voice, but I don't think he'll catch on with young people.
cn: 这位歌手拥有一副好嗓子，但我认为他不会受到年轻人的喜爱。

en: What must one keep in mind during a kiss, above all else? The singer Max Raabe answers this important question.
cn: 接吻时最该注意的是什么？歌手马克斯拉贝回答了这个重要的问题。

en: If you are a China fan, maybe read the article "Origins of Tones in Old Chinese."
cn: 如果你是中国文化爱好者，或许可以读《古汉语声调的起源》这篇文章。

en: It'll be hard to find a good vocalist who isn't already working with another band.
cn: 很难找到一位没有在其他乐团工作的优秀主唱。

en: You can skip stage three of the certification process and advance immediately to stage six.
cn: 您可以跳过认证过程的第三阶段，直接进入第六阶段。

en: The Palestinian children that were arrested in June 2018 are being held in the Ofer prison.
cn: 2018 年 6 月被捕的巴勒斯坦儿童被关押在奥弗监狱。

en: In Japan, the rainy season lasts from the beginning of June to the middle of July.
cn: 在日本，梅雨季节从六月初持续到七月中旬。

en: My favorite stories are "Anne of Green Gables", "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer" and "Heidi, Girl of the Alps".
cn: 我最喜欢的故事是《绿山墙的安妮》、《汤姆索亚历险记》和《阿尔卑斯山的少女海蒂》。

en: Pachamama is a goddess of earth and fertility revered by the indigenous peoples of the Andes.
cn: 帕查玛玛是安地斯山脉土着居民敬仰的大地和生育女神。

en: Thousands of laborers and craftsmen toiled for 22 years to craft the stunning white marble edifice.
cn: 数千名工人和工匠辛勤工作了 22 年，才打造出这座令人惊叹的白色大理石建筑。

en: Russia is sending battleships, marines, and landing craft tanks against Syria, and submarine equiment against Iran.
cn: 俄罗斯正向叙利亚派遣战舰、海军陆战队和登陆艇坦克，并向伊朗派遣潜舰装备。

en: Crafting a perfect Mojito can be a challenge. Achieving the right balance of sweetness, mintiness, and lime is an art.
cn: 调制一杯完美的 Mojito 并非易事。要达到甜味、薄荷味和青柠味之间的完美平衡，是一门艺术。

en: To strengthen his position, Tom surrounded himself with intellectuals and church dignitaries, one of whom was Brother John.
cn: 为了巩固自己的地位，汤姆身边聚集了一群知识分子和教会要员，其中一位就是约翰弟兄。

en: On the weekend, our whole family went to eat Sichuan food and ordered mapo tofu and husband-and-wife lung slices.
cn: 周末我们全家去吃四川菜，点了麻婆豆腐和夫妻肺片。

en: People often say: "If something in your hand no longer feels right, it's better to let it go."
cn: 人们常说拿在手里没有感觉的东西还是放手的好。

en: When I was little, I often lay on the grass and watched the white clouds in the sky.
cn: 我小时候常常躺在草地上看天上的白云。

en: The father was strong all his life, and what he hated most was seeing his son live like a loser.
cn: 父亲一生刚强，最痛恨的就是儿子活成个窝囊废的样子。

en: The king, convinced, told the tailors to prepare the outfit, but he also couldn't see this material.
cn: 国王听信了骗子的话，吩咐裁缝师准备这套服装，但其实裁缝师也看不见这块布料。

en: Merry Christmas! What right have you to be merry? What reason have you to be merry?
cn: 圣诞节快乐！你有什么权利快乐？你有什么理由快乐？

en: She expects to have finished her second novel by November, just in time for Christmas.
cn: 她预计将在 11 月完成第二本小说，正好赶上圣诞节。

en: When travelling, I always go to the airport in Nanjing, I've never been to Shanghai.
cn: 我出去玩都是在南京坐飞机，没去过上海。

en: I didn't know what to do when Tom and Mary said they wouldn't help me.
cn: 汤姆和玛莉说不会帮我，我不知道该怎么办。

en: It's just an attempt on his part to maximize profits, as much as possible, in the last moments of negotiations.
cn: 这不过是他在谈判最后时刻尽可能最大化利润的尝试。

en: Your problem is that you think you have to do everything your parents tell you to do.
cn: 你的问题在于，你认为你必须听从父母的一切指示。

en: They're creating stunning works of art to force people to stop and appreciate the beauty of the universe.
cn: 他们创作出令人惊叹的艺术作品，从而让人们驻足欣赏宇宙之美。

en: You'd be doing me a favour if you'd let me help you to speed things along.
cn: 你如果让我帮忙加快进度，同样也是在帮我一个忙。

en: If you're so dissatisfied with what I'm doing, you'd be better off doing it yourself.
cn: 你要是这么不满意我做的，自己来做好了。

en: Does anyone know a good method of eating avocados that will bring out their taste?
cn: 有谁知道怎么吃酪梨才能更好地凸显它的味道？

en: I bought a house on a small hill in southern France in preparation of building a retirement home.
cn: 我在法国南边的一座小山买了一所房子，准备在那里建设老人院。

en: I didn't know that you were planning on doing that before you went home today.
cn: 我不知道你今天回家之前本来是要那样做。

en: Find me tomorrow morning. I'll be sitting on the café patio reading a newspaper and wearing a Hawaiian shirt.
cn: 明天早上来找我。我会坐在咖啡厅的露天座位，看着报纸，穿着夏威夷衫。

en: Is that a car accident? Crap, now I'll never make it to work on time!
cn: 那是出车祸了吗？可恶，我现在绝对来不及准时上班了！

en: I sent in my dashcam video and the other driver was found at fault for the accident.
cn: 我提交了行车记录器的影片，结果认定对方驾驶要负事故责任。

en: The area of a general quadrilateral cannot be written as a function of its side lengths.
cn: 一般四边形的面积无法表示为其边长的函数。

en: I ate a bunch of Taco Bell and now I have a serious case of the shits.
cn: 我吃了一堆塔可钟，现在肚子拉得很惨。

en: Heron's Formula shows how the area of a triangle can be expressed as a function of its side lengths.
cn: 海龙公式说明了三角形的面积如何表示为其边长的函数。

en: A holomorphic function can be expressed as a convergent power series in a neighborhood of any point in its domain.
cn: 全纯函数在其定义域内任意一点的邻域中都可以表示为收敛的幂级数。

en: His only hope of winning the pool game at that point was to successfully execute a complex trick shot.
cn: 那时他赢得撞球比赛的唯一希望，就是成功打出一记复杂的花式击球。

en: This is me on the beach, and this one is me playing with my dog.
cn: 这张是我在海滩上，这张是我在跟我的狗玩。

en: There's one surefire way to live to a ripe old age: eat a meatball a day for a hundred years.
cn: 想长命百岁有一个万无一失的方法：每天吃一颗狮子头，吃一百年。

en: On March 1, President Donald Trump has signed an executive order making English the official language of the United States.
cn: 3 月 1 日，唐纳德・特朗普总统签署了一项行政命令，将英语定为美国的官方语言。

en: I hate when the driver in front of me hits the brakes for no reason.
cn: 我讨厌前面的车毫无缘故地突然煞车。

en: Are the cleaning fee and tourism fee for the room already included in the listed daily rate?
cn: 房间的清洁费和旅游税已经包含在清单上的每日房费里了吗？

en: The billiard ball bounced off of three different sides of the table before landing in a side pocket.
cn: 那颗撞球在桌面的三个边框上各回弹了一下，最后落入一个边袋。

en: On a 19x19 lines board, Go is played with 361 stones (181 black and 180 white).
cn: 围棋使用十九路棋盘，共 361 颗棋子 (181 颗黑子与 180 颗白子)。

en: Next time you talk back to me like that, I'm grounding you on the spot, young lady.
cn: 你下次再这样顶嘴，我就禁足你，小姐。

en: Many companies have attempted to manufacture this complex component at scale, but so far only ours has succeeded.
cn: 许多公司都尝试过大规模生产这种复杂的零件，但目前只有我们成功了。

en: Software development as an industry is very adaptable, so it's unclear whether AI will significantly disrupt the programming job market.
cn: 软体开发业的适应力很强，因此 AI 是否会对程式设计的就业市场造成重大冲击，目前仍不明朗。

en: The military treatise authored by Sun Tzu is, to this day, required reading in military academies all across the world.
cn: 孙子所着的兵法，至今仍是各国军事学院的必读经典。

en: Thanks for having explained to me at last why people take me for an idiot.
cn: 感谢您终于为我说明了为甚么人们通通把我当傻瓜。

en: Did the Duke of Zhou dream of the butterfly, or did the butterfly dream of the Duke of Zhou?
cn: 究竟是周公梦到了蝴蝶，还是蝴蝶梦到了周公？

en: Can you please leave us a list of instructions for how to take care of your pets while you're gone?
cn: 你离开的这段时间，关于怎么照顾你的宠物，可以麻烦你留一份说明给我们吗？

en: People are bad; they only think of themselves. I'm the only one who thinks about me.
cn: 人们都很坏，他们只想着他们自己，只剩下我为自己着想。

en: How many doughnuts can you eat on an empty stomach? Just one. After the first one your stomach isn't empty.
cn: 空腹能吃几个甜甜圈？只能吃一个。吃了第一个之后，肚子就不空了。

en: This formula is valid for all complex numbers z with a real part greater than zero.
cn: 此公式对所有实部大于零的复数 z 均成立。

en: Tom told his son that he had to eat everything that was on his plate.
cn: 汤姆告诉儿子，盘子里的东西都要吃完。

en: As a stranger in a strange land, the sporadic solicitude from friends can be especially heart-warming.
cn: 在异乡生活，偶尔收到朋友的关怀让人倍感温暖。

en: Everyone has the right to freedom of movement and residence within the borders of each State.
cn: 每个人在各国境内均享有迁徙自由与居住自由的权利。

en: The leader of Myanmar's pro-democracy movement, Aung San Suu Kyi, has been in detainment for over 10 years.
cn: 缅甸民主运动领袖昂山素姬已遭拘押逾十年。

en: The "drop the T" movement was started by a guy who now identifies as ex-gay.
cn: 「去 T 运动」是由一名现在自称已脱离同性恋的男子发起的。

en: We reached our destination just as I thought the car was going to give up the ghost.
cn: 我们抵达目的地的时候，我还以为那辆车快要报废了。

en: When I saw the ghost, I was so frightened that my hair stood on end.
cn: 看到鬼的时候，我吓得汗毛直竖。

en: Get into the left lane to make room for the guy who's trying to merge.
cn: 移到左线，为想并入的那辆车腾出空间。

en: Enjambment is when a sentence from one line of poetry spills over into the next line.
cn: 跨行是指一句话在诗歌中从一行跨到下一行的情况。

en: No, I'm not waiting for you, but know that I've loved for the last time.
cn: 我不是在等你。但你要知道，我已经爱过最后一次。

en: Do you have an objection to the source, or a relevant piece of evidence to refute the claim?
cn: 你是对来源有异议，还是有相关的证据可以反驳这个说法呢？

en: The best refutation of the imaginary Malthusian laws of "land depletion" is the practice of Soviet collective farming.
cn: 对马尔萨斯虚构的「土地耗尽」定律最有力的反驳，是苏联集体农场的时间。

en: Bees pollinate flowers and trees, and collect nectar to make honey, bee glue and bee venom.
cn: 蜜蜂为花卉和树木授粉，并采集花蜜来制造蜂蜜、蜂胶和蜂毒。

en: There's another reason, isn't there? Well, how did I do? I bet I hit the mark.
cn: 那肯定有别的理由，怎幺样，被我说中了吧？

en: He said that he had left his purse at home and asked me if I could lend him 1,000 yen.
cn: 他说他把钱包落在家里了，然后问我能不能借他1000日元。

en: Most of the words are faded, but it's still possible to extrapolate the meaning from these sentences.
cn: 大部分的字迹已经褪色，但仍可从这些句子中推敲出含意。

en: The word came to be used for all small heavenly bodies revolving about larger ones.
cn: 这个词后来被用来指代围绕大天体的小天体。

en: I realized how fortunate I was and how many second chances life has given me.
cn: 我意识到我是多幺的幸运，命运给了我这幺多重来的机会。

en: Elon Musk embodies the conservative propaganda tactic of calling everyone who crosses you a pedophile.
cn: 伊隆马斯克将「凡是与你作对的人都是恋童癖」这一保守派惯用的抹黑手法发挥得淋漓尽致。

en: Bicycles wear out, of course, but with proper care they may be made to last a long time.
cn: 自行车当然会磨损，但只要你保养得好，就能骑很长一段时间。

en: Though it is poor in natural resources, Japan has become an economic superpower thanks to international trade.
cn: 日本即便是自然资源匮乏，却仍得益于国际贸易，成为了一个强大的经济体。

en: Yesterday I met an old friend of mine whom I had not seen for a long time.
cn: 我昨天遇到了一个许久不见的老朋友。

en: Four brave military dogs were awarded the K-9 Medal of Courage for their bravery and service.
cn: 四只英勇的军犬因其勇气与贡献获颁 K-9 勇气勋章。

en: She took me by the hand and begged me to tell no one what had happened.
cn: 她拉住我的手，求我不要把发生的事告诉别人。

en: The age of a tree can be determined from the annual rings seen on a saw cut.
cn: 根据木头切面的年轮，可以判断树的年龄。

en: Although this sentence has no grammatical mistakes, I think it would practically never be used.
cn: 这句话虽然语法没错，但我认为现实中几乎没人会这幺说。

en: Sadako realized that, near death, even what was once mundane glows with an everlasting beauty.
cn: 贞子意识到，在生命将尽之际，曾经平凡无奇的事物，也会散发永恒的美。

en: The printer of my company broke down again, so I'm going to the convenience store to copy documents.
cn: 因为公司的打印机又坏了，我要去便利店打印文件。

en: You could at least try to be a bit more polite, even though it's not like you.
cn: 无论你平时怎幺大大咧咧的，起码试着稍微礼貌一点吧。

en: He's taken off his mask, torn off his costume. There's no doubt now about what the far-right candidate intends.
cn: 他摘下了面具，卸下了伪装。极右翼候选人的意图已昭然若揭。

en: Eating smaller portions from smaller plates can help you eat less while not feeling hungry any quicker.
cn: 用小餐盘打饭可以帮助你减少食量而不至于那幺快感到饥饿。

en: Hi, I need a taxi to come to the entrance of No.40, Lane 200, Huashan Road right now.
cn: 喂，我要一辆的士，现在就到华山路200弄40号门口。

en: I'm beginning to stop seeing people wearing bulky glasses like that of the bottom of a milk bottle.
cn: 镜片像牛奶瓶底一样厚的那种眼镜，我不太看到有人戴了。

en: The films shown in this modest cinema had an intermission during which the projectionist changed the reel.
cn: 这座规模不大的电影院在放映影片时会有一段中场休息，期间放映师负责换片。

en: Why does the computer crash every time I run a program? Simply because I can't afford a good computer.
cn: 为什幺电脑一跑程序，就崩溃？还不是因为我没钱买好电脑。

en: Put your hard hat on. You might well get a brick fall on your head here.
cn: 把安全帽戴上。这里很可能会有砖块砸到你头上。

en: On the winter solstice we have a hot bath with yuzu citrus fruits in it.
cn: 冬至时，我们泡热水澡，池中会加柚子。

en: A cloud of dust and debris rose and lingered in the sky for a few minutes afterward.
cn: 一团尘土与瓦砾腾空而起，在空中盘旋了数分钟。

en: I think a change of ruling party in Hungary will result in WWIII breaking out.
cn: 我认为匈牙利的执政党轮换将导致三战爆发。

en: Whether you believe it or not, I want to get this thing over with as much as you do.
cn: 不管你信不信，我和你一样巴不得想把这件事搞定。

en: Time is running out. You need to marry your boyfriend and have a baby before it's too late.
cn: 时间不等人。你应该趁早和你男朋友结婚，生个孩子，免得到时候追悔莫及。

en: So many Chinese characters have been accepted into Unicode. Are all of them actually used?
cn: Unicode里收了这幺多汉字字符，有些真的有用吗？
